This document begins with an overview of the AMD CDNA processors' hardware and programming environment (Chapter 1). Chapter 2 describes the organization of CDNA programs. Chapter 3 describes the program state that is maintained. Chapter 4 describes the program flow. Chapter 5 describes the scalar ALU operations. Chapter 6 describes the vector ALU operations. Chapter 7 describes the vector Matrix ALU operations. Chapter 8 describes the scalar memory operations. Chapter 9 describes the vector memory operations. Chapter 10 provides information about the flat memory instructions. Chapter 11 describes the data share operations. Chapter 12 describes instruction details, first by the microcode format to which they belong, then in alphabetic order. Finally, Chapter 13 provides a detailed specification of each microcode format.

第 1 章 简介

Chapter 1. Introduction

AMD CDNA 处理器实现了并行微架构，旨在为通用数据并行应用提供出色的平台。需要高带宽或计算密集型的数据密集型应用程序适合在 AMD CDNA 处理器上运行。

查看英文原文

AMD CDNA processors implement a parallel micro-architecture that is designed to provide an excellent platform for general-purpose data parallel applications. Data-intensive applications that require high bandwidth or are computationally intensive are a candidate for running on an AMD CDNA processor.

下图为 AMD CDNA 一代系列处理器的框图

查看英文原文

The figure below shows a block diagram of the AMD CDNA Generation series processors

图 1. AMD CDNA 一代系列框图

查看英文原文

Figure 1. AMD CDNA Generation Series Block Diagram

CDNA 器件包括数据并行处理器(DPP)阵列、命令处理器、内存控制器和其他逻辑(未示出)。 CDNA 命令处理器读取主机写入系统内存地址空间中的内存映射 CDNA 寄存器的命令。当命令完成时，命令处理器向主机发送硬件生成的中断。 CDNA 内存控制器可以直接访问所有 CDNA 器件内存和主机指定的系统内存区域。为了满足读写请求，内存控制器执行直接内存访问 (DMA) 控制器的功能，包括根据内存中请求的数据格式计算内存地址偏移量。在 CDNA 环境中，一个完整的应用程序包括两部分：

查看英文原文

The CDNA device includes a data-parallel processor (DPP) array, a command processor, a memory controller, and other logic (not shown). The CDNA command processor reads commands that the host has written to memory-mapped CDNA registers in the system-memory address space. The command processor sends hardware-generated interrupts to the host when the command is completed. The CDNA memory controller has direct access to all CDNA device memory and the host-specified areas of system memory. To satisfy read and write requests, the memory controller performs the functions of a direct-memory access (DMA) controller, including computing memory-address offsets based on the format of the requested data in memory. In the CDNA environment, a complete application includes two parts:

在主机处理器上运行的程序，以及

查看英文原文

a program running on the host processor, and

名为核函数的程序在 CDNA 处理器上运行。

查看英文原文

programs, called kernels, running on the CDNA processor.

CDNA 程序由主机命令控制

查看英文原文

The CDNA programs are controlled by host commands that

设置 CDNA 内部基址和其他配置寄存器，

查看英文原文

set CDNA internal base-address and other configuration registers,

指定 CDNA 加速器要运行的数据域，

查看英文原文

specify the data domain on which the CDNA Accelerator is to operate,

使 CDNA 加速器的缓存失效，并执行缓存刷新；

查看英文原文

invalidate and flush caches on the CDNA Accelerator, and

使 CDNA 加速器开始执行程序。

查看英文原文

cause the CDNA Accelerator to begin execution of a program.

CDNA 驱动程序运行在主机上。

查看英文原文

The CDNA driver program runs on the host.

原 PDF 第 12 页

DPP 阵列是 CDNA 处理器的核心，由多条相互独立的计算单元流水线组成，并行处理浮点或整数数据流。计算单元流水线可以处理数据，也可以通过内存控制器在处理器与内存之间传输数据。流水线中的计算和向内存写入结果都可以按条件执行。

查看英文原文

The DPP array is the heart of the CDNA processor. The array is organized as a set of compute unit pipelines, each independent from the others, that are designed to operate in parallel on streams of floating-point or integer data. The compute unit pipelines can process data or, through the memory controller, transfer data to, or from, memory. Computation in a compute unit pipeline can be made conditional. Outputs written to memory can also be made conditional.

收到请求后，计算单元流水线从内存加载指令和数据，开始执行，直到核函数结束。核函数运行期间，CDNA 硬件自动将指令从内存取入片上缓存，无需 CDNA 软件参与。CDNA 核函数可以将片外内存中的数据加载到片上通用寄存器（GPRs）和缓存中。

查看英文原文

When it receives a request, the compute unit pipeline loads instructions and data from memory, begins execution, and continues until the end of the kernel. As kernels are running, the CDNA hardware automatically fetches instructions from memory into on-chip caches; CDNA software plays no role in this. CDNA kernels can load data from off-chip memory into on-chip general-purpose registers (GPRs) and caches.

AMD CDNA 设备能够检测浮点异常并产生中断。其中，硬件可检测 IEEE 浮点异常，并记录这些异常，供程序执行后分析。前图从命令处理器指向主机、标作软件中断的路径，表示由硬件产生的中断，用于通知命令完成及相关管理事件。

查看英文原文

The AMD CDNA devices can detect floating point exceptions and can generate interrupts. In particular, they can detect IEEE floating-point exceptions in hardware; these can be recorded for post-execution analysis. The software interrupts shown in the previous figure from the command processor to the host represent hardware-generated interrupts for signaling command-completion and related management functions.

CDNA 处理器旨在通过跟踪不同执行阶段中潜在的数百个工作项以及通过将计算操作与内存访问操作重叠来隐藏内存延迟。

查看英文原文

The CDNA processor is designed to hide memory latency by keeping track of potentially hundreds of work-items in different stages of execution, and by overlapping compute operations with memory-access operations.

第 2 章 程序组织

查看英文原文

Chapter 2. Program Organization

CDNA 核函数是由 CDNA 处理器执行的程序。从编程模型看，每个工作项独立执行核函数；实际执行时，CDNA 处理器把 64 个工作项组成一个波前，在一次执行过程中为这 64 个工作项运行核函数。

查看英文原文

CDNA kernels are programs executed by the CDNA processor. Conceptually, the kernel is executed independently on every work-item, but in reality the CDNA processor groups 64 work-items into a wavefront, which executes the kernel on all 64 work-items in one pass.

CDNA 处理器包括：

查看英文原文

The CDNA processor consists of:

标量 ALU：每个波前操作一个由所有工作项共用的值。

查看英文原文

A scalar ALU, which operates on one value per wavefront (common to all work items).

向量 ALU：操作各工作项各自的值。

查看英文原文

A vector ALU, which operates on unique values per work-item.

本地数据存储，允许工作组内的工作项进行通信和共享数据。

查看英文原文

Local data storage, which allows work-items within a workgroup to communicate and share data.

标量内存单元：通过缓存在 SGPRs 与内存之间传输数据。

查看英文原文

Scalar memory, which can transfer data between SGPRs and memory through a cache.

向量内存单元：在 VGPRs 与内存之间传输数据。

查看英文原文

Vector memory, which can transfer data between VGPRs and memory

核函数的所有控制流均由标量 ALU 指令处理，包括 if/else、分支和循环。标量 ALU（SALU）指令及标量内存指令作用于整个波前，可操作最多两个 SGPRs，以及字面量常量。

查看英文原文

All kernel control flow is handled using scalar ALU instructions. This includes if/else, branches and looping. Scalar ALU (SALU) and memory instructions work on an entire wavefront and operate on up to two SGPRs, as well as literal constants.

向量内存指令和向量 ALU 指令同时作用于波前中的所有工作项。为支持分支和条件执行，每个波前都有 EXEC 执行掩码，指定当前哪些工作项处于活动状态、哪些处于休眠状态。活动工作项执行向量指令，休眠工作项将该指令视为空操作（NOP）。标量 ALU 指令可以随时修改 EXEC 掩码。

查看英文原文

Vector memory and ALU instructions operate on all work-items in the wavefront at one time. In order to support branching and conditional execute, every wavefront has an EXECute mask that determines which work-items are active at that moment, and which are dormant. Active work-items execute the vector instruction, and dormant ones treat the instruction as a NOP. The EXEC mask can be changed at any time by Scalar ALU instructions.

向量 ALU 指令最多接收三个参数，可来自 VGPRs、SGPRs，或指令流中的字面量常量。指令作用于 EXEC 掩码使能的所有工作项。向量比较指令和带进位输出的加法指令会向 SGPRs 返回掩码，每个工作项对应一位，分别表示比较结果是否为真或是否产生进位。

查看英文原文

Vector ALU instructions can take up to three arguments, which can come from VGPRs, SGPRs, or literal constants that are part of the instruction stream. They operate on all work-items enabled by the EXEC mask. Vector compare and add with- carryout return a bit-per-work-item mask back to the SGPRs to indicate, per work-item, which had a "true" result from the compare or generated a carry-out.

向量内存指令在 VGPRs 与内存之间传输数据。每个工作项提供各自的内存地址，并提供或接收各自的数据。这些指令也受 EXEC 掩码控制。

查看英文原文

Vector memory instructions transfer data between VGPRs and memory. Each work-item supplies its own memory address and supplies or receives unique data. These instructions are also subject to the EXEC mask.

2.1. 计算着色器

查看英文原文

2.1. Compute Shaders

计算核函数（着色器）是在 CDNA 处理器上运行的通用程序：从内存读取数据，处理后将结果写回内存。一次派发使 CDNA 处理器为一维、二维或三维数据网格中的所有工作项执行核函数。CDNA 处理器遍历网格并生成波前，由波前运行计算核函数。初始化时，每个工作项获得自己在网格中的唯一地址（索引），再据此计算待处理数据的地址，并决定如何处理结果。

查看英文原文

Compute kernels (shaders) are generic programs that can run on the CDNA processor, taking data from memory, processing it, and writing results back to memory. Compute kernels are created by a dispatch, which causes the CDNA processors to run the kernel over all of the work-items in a 1D, 2D, or 3D grid of data. The CDNA processor walks through this grid and generates wavefronts, which then run the compute kernel. Each work-item is initialized with its unique address (index) within the grid. Based on this index, the work-item computes the address of the data it is required to work on and what to do with the results.

2.2.1. 本地数据共享（LDS）

查看英文原文

2.2.1. Local Data Share (LDS)

每个计算单元具​​有 64kB 内存空间，可实现工作组内的工作项或波前内的工作项之间的低延迟通信；这是本地数据共享 (LDS)。该内存配置有 32 个存储体，每个存储体有 512 个 4 字节条目。共享内存包含 32 个整数原子单元，旨在实现快速、无序的原子操作。该内存可用作可预测地重用数据的软件缓存、工作组工作项的数据交换机，或作为一种协作方式来实现对片外内存的高效访问。

查看英文原文

Each compute unit has a 64kB memory space that enables low-latency communication between work-items within a work-group, or the work-items within a wavefront; this is the local data share (LDS). This memory is configured with 32 banks, each with 512 entries of 4 bytes. The shared memory contains 32 integer atomic units designed to enable fast, unordered atomic operations. This memory can be used as a software cache for predictable re-use of data, a data exchange machine for the work-items of a work-group, or as a cooperative way to enable efficient access to off-chip memory.

2.2.2. 全局波前同步（GWS）

查看英文原文

2.2.2. Global Wave Sync (GWS)

AMD CDNA 器件包含一个全局同步单元 (GWS)，能够跨器件同步工作组。使用此功能的指令有时称为“GDS”。

查看英文原文

The AMD CDNA devices contain a global synchronization unit (GWS) capable of synchronizing workgroups across the device. Instructions which use this capability are sometimes referred to as "GDS".

2.3. 设备内存

查看英文原文

2.3. Device Memory

AMD CDNA 器件提供了多种从每个计算单元内的处理元件 (PE) 访问片外内存的方法。在主读取路径上，该器件由多个通道的 L2 读写缓存组成，为每个计算单元的 L1 缓存提供数据。特定的无缓存加载指令可以强制在执行加载子句期间从设备内存中检索数据。子句中重叠的加载请求会相互缓存。输出缓存由两级缓存组成：第一级用于写组合缓存（收集分散和存储操作并将它们组合起来以提供良好的内存访问模式）；第二个是具有原子单元的读/写缓存，它允许每个处理元素完成返回初始值的无序原子访问。每个处理元素提供原子操作作用的目标地址、原子操作中要使用的数据以及

查看英文原文

The AMD CDNA devices offer several methods for access to off-chip memory from the processing elements (PE) within each compute unit. On the primary read path, the device consists of multiple channels of L2 read-write cache that provides data to an L1 cache for each compute unit. Specific cache-less load instructions can force data to be retrieved from device memory during an execution of a load clause. Load requests that overlap within the clause are cached with respect to each other. The output cache is formed by two levels of cache: the first for write-combining cache (collect scatter and store operations and combine them to provide good access patterns to memory); the second is a read/write cache with atomic units that lets each processing element complete unordered atomic accesses that return the initial value. Each processing element provides the destination address on which the atomic operation acts, the data to be used in the atomic operation, and a

读/写原子单元的返回地址，用于将预操作值存储在内存中。每个存储或原子操作都可以设置为在返回值（目的地的前原子操作值）存储到设备内存的写入确认后，向请求的 PE 返回确认。

查看英文原文

return address for the read/write atomic unit to store the pre-op value in memory. Each store or atomic operation can be set up to return an acknowledgment to the requesting PE upon write confirmation of the return value (pre-atomic op value at destination) being stored to device memory.

此确认有两个目的：

查看英文原文

This acknowledgment has two purposes:

使 PE 能够在收到写确认确认后通过从其返回地址执行无缓存加载来从原子操作中恢复预操作值，以及

查看英文原文

enabling a PE to recover the pre-op value from an atomic operation by performing a cache-less load from its return address after receipt of the write confirmation acknowledgment, and

使系统能够维持宽松的一致性模型。

查看英文原文

enabling the system to maintain a relaxed consistency model.

从给定 PE 到给定内存通道的每次分散写入都会保持顺序。该确认使一个处理元件能够实现栅栏，以通过确保所有写入在完成后续写入之前已被发布到内存来维持串行一致性。通过这种方式，系统可以在系统上运行的所有并行工作项之间维持宽松的一致性模型。

查看英文原文

Each scatter write from a given PE to a given memory channel maintains order. The acknowledgment enables one processing element to implement a fence to maintain serial consistency by ensuring all writes have been posted to memory prior to completing a subsequent write. In this manner, the system can maintain a relaxed consistency model between all parallel work-items operating on the system.

3.2. 程序计数器（PC）

3.2. Program Counter (PC)

程序计数器（PC）保存下一条待执行指令的字节地址。创建波前时，PC 初始化为程序中第一条指令的地址。

查看英文原文

The program counter (PC) is a byte address pointing to the next instruction to execute. When a wavefront is created, the PC is initialized to the first instruction in the program.

S_GET_PC、S_SET_PC 和 S_SWAP_PC 三条指令用于在 PC 与一对按偶数编号对齐的 SGPR 之间传输数据。

查看英文原文

The PC interacts with three instructions: S_GET_PC, S_SET_PC, S_SWAP_PC. These transfer the PC to, and from, an even-aligned SGPR pair.

分支目标地址为（PC_of_the_instruction_after_the_branch + offset）。着色器程序不能直接读写 PC。分支指令、GET_PC 和 SWAP_PC 以其下一条指令的 PC 为相对地址基准，而非当前指令的 PC。S_TRAP 保存 S_TRAP 指令自身的 PC。

查看英文原文

Branches jump to (PC_of_the_instruction_after_the_branch + offset). The shader program cannot directly read from, or write to, the PC. Branches, GET_PC and SWAP_PC, are PC-relative to the next instruction, not the current one. S_TRAP saves the PC of the S_TRAP instruction itself.

3.3. EXEC 执行掩码

查看英文原文

3.3. EXECute Mask

执行掩码（64 位）确定执行向量中的哪些线程：1 = 执行，0 = 不执行。

查看英文原文

The Execute mask (64-bit) determines which threads in the vector are executed: 1 = execute, 0 = do not execute.

标量指令可以读写 EXEC，向量 ALU 比较指令也可以将比较结果写入 EXEC。该掩码控制向量 ALU、向量内存和 LDS 指令，不影响标量执行或分支。

查看英文原文

EXEC can be read from, and written to, through scalar instructions; it also can be written as a result of a vector-ALU compare. This mask affects vector-ALU, vector-memory, and LDS instructions. It does not affect scalar execution or branches.

当 EXEC 为零时，辅助位 (EXECZ) 可用作分支跳过代码的条件。

查看英文原文

A helper bit (EXECZ) can be used as a condition for branches to skip code when EXEC is zero.

EXEC = 0 时，该加速器不会自动优化：着色器硬件仍执行每条指令，消耗指令发射带宽。当 EXEC 掩码可能为零时，应使用 CBRANCH 或 VSKIP 快速跳过代码。

查看英文原文

This Accelerator does no optimization when EXEC = 0. The shader hardware executes every instruction, wasting instruction issue bandwidth. Use CBRANCH or VSKIP to rapidly skip over code when it is likely that the EXEC mask is zero.

3.6.2. SGPR 分配与存储

查看英文原文

3.6.2. SGPR Allocation and storage

一个波前可以分配 16 到 102 个 SGPRs，以 16 个 GPRs（双字）为单位。这些在逻辑上被视为 SGPRs 0-101。 VCC 作为波前的 SGPRs 的一部分物理存储在编号最高的两个 SGPRs 中（SGPR 106 和 107；源/目标 VCC 是这两个 SGPRs 的别名）。当存在陷阱处理程序时，在 VCC 之后保留 16 个额外的 SGPRs 以保存陷阱地址以及保存的 PC 和陷阱处理程序温度。这些都是有特权的（除非设置了特权，否则无法写入）。请注意，如果波前分配 16 个 SGPRs，则 2 个 SGPRs 通常用作 VCC，其余 14 个可供着色器使用。着色器硬件并不妨碍使用所有 16 个 SGPRs。

查看英文原文

A wavefront can be allocated 16 to 102 SGPRs, in units of 16 GPRs (Dwords). These are logically viewed as SGPRs 0-101. The VCC is physically stored as part of the wavefront’s SGPRs in the highest numbered two SGPRs (SGPR 106 and 107; the source/destination VCC is an alias for those two SGPRs). When a trap handler is present, 16 additional SGPRs are reserved after VCC to hold the trap addresses, as well as saved-PC and trap-handler temps. These all are privileged (cannot be written to unless privilege is set). Note that if a wavefront allocates 16 SGPRs, 2 SGPRs are typically used as VCC, the remaining 14 are available to the shader. Shader hardware does not prevent use of all 16 SGPRs.

当标量内存读取地址基数来自 SGPR 对时（在 SGPR 中）。

When scalar memory reads that the address-base comes from an SGPR-pair (either in SGPR).

当标量内存读取返回四个或更多双字时，数据 GPR 需要四对齐。当 SGPRs 中存储 64 位数量时，LSB 位于 SGPR[n]，MSB 位于 SGPR[n+1]。

查看英文原文

Quad-alignment is required for the data-GPR when a scalar memory read returns four or more Dwords. When a 64-bit quantity is stored in SGPRs, the LSBs are in SGPR[n], and the MSBs are in SGPR[n+1].

3.6.5. LDS 分配与边界限制

查看英文原文

3.6.5. LDS Allocation and Clamping

当工作组未使用时，LDS 按工作组或按波前分配。 LDS 空间按 512 字节对齐方式分配给工作组或波前的连续 512 字节块。 LDS 分配不会环绕 LDS 存储。对 LDS 的所有访问都仅限于分配给该波前/工作组的空间。

查看英文原文

LDS is allocated per work-group or per-wavefront when work-groups are not in use. LDS space is allocated to a work-group or wavefront in contiguous blocks of 512 bytes on 512-byte alignment. LDS allocations do not wrap around the LDS storage. All accesses to LDS are restricted to the space allocated to that wavefront/work-group.

LDS 读取和写入的钳位由两个大小寄存器控制，其中包含 SPI 分配给该波前或工作组的 LDS 空间大小的值，以及 LDS 指令中指定的可能较小的值（大小保存在 M0 中）。 LDS 操作使用这两个大小中较小的一个来确定如何钳位读/写地址。

查看英文原文

Clamping of LDS reads and writes is controlled by two size registers, which contain values for the size of the LDS space allocated by SPI to this wavefront or work-group, and a possibly smaller value specified in the LDS instruction (size is held in M0). The LDS operations use the smaller of these two sizes to determine how to clamp the read/write addresses.

查看英文原文

3.10. Trap and Exception registers

每种例外都可以通过设置或清除 TRAPSTS 注册的 EXCP_EN 字段中的位数而独立启用或禁用。本节介绍控制和报告核函数例外的注册。

查看英文原文

Each type of exception can be enabled or disabled independently by setting, or clearing, bits in the TRAPSTS register’s EXCP_EN field. This section describes the registers which control and report kernel exceptions.

所有陷阱临时 SGPRs(TTMP*)都享有写作特权——只有在陷阱处理器(status.priv = 1)中才能写作,当不享有特权时,写作会被忽略并读回零. TMA 和 TBA 只读;它们可以通过 S_GETREG_B32 访问.

查看英文原文

All Trap temporary SGPRs (TTMP*) are privileged for writes - they can be written only when in the trap handler (status.priv = 1). When not privileged, writes to these are ignored and reads return zero. TMA and TBA are read-only; they can be accessed through S_GETREG_B32.

当设定陷阱( 用户启动、 例外或主机启动) 时, 阴影硬件会生成 S_ TRAP 指令。 这将陷阱信息加载到一对 SGPRS 中 :

查看英文原文

When a trap is taken (either user initiated, exception or host initiated), the shader hardware generates an S_TRAP instruction. This loads trap information into a pair of SGPRS:

HT 被设定为主机启动的陷阱一个,而用户陷阱(s_trap)或例外为零. TRAP_ID 是例外的零,或者这些陷阱的用户/主机陷阱 ID. 输入陷阱处理器时,断层指令的 PC 是: (PC - PC_rewind*4).

查看英文原文

HT is set to one for host initiated traps, and zero for user traps (s_trap) or exceptions. TRAP_ID is zero for exceptions, or the user/host trapID for those traps. When the trap handler is entered, the PC of the faulting instruction is: (PC - PC_rewind*4).

Chapter 4. Program Flow Control

所有程序流程控制均使用标量 ALU 指令进行编程。这包括循环、分支、子例程调用和陷阱。程序使用 SGPRs 来存储分支条件和循环计数器。常量可以从标量常量缓存中直接提取到 SGPRs 中。

查看英文原文

All program flow control is programmed using scalar ALU instructions. This includes loops, branches, subroutine calls, and traps. The program uses SGPRs to store branch conditions and loop counters. Constants can be fetched from the scalar constant cache directly into SGPRs.

对于条件分支，分支条件可以通过标量或向量运算来确定。标量比较操作设置标量条件码 (SCC)，然后可以将其用作条件分支条件。向量比较操作设置 VCC 掩码，然后 VCCZ 或 VCCNZ 可用于确定分支。

查看英文原文

For conditional branches, the branch condition can be determined by either scalar or vector operations. A scalar compare operation sets the Scalar Condition Code (SCC), which then can be used as a conditional branch condition. Vector compare operations set the VCC mask, and VCCZ or VCCNZ then can be used to determine branching.

4.3. 工作组

查看英文原文

4.3. Workgroups

工作组是在同一计算单元上运行的波前的集合，可以同步和共享数据。最多可将 16 个波前 (1024 工作项) 组合成一个工作组。当多个波前在一个工作组中时，可以使用 S_BARRIER 指令强制每个波前等待，直到所有其他波前到达相同的指令；然后，一切波前继续。任何波前都可以使用 S_ENDPGM 提前终止，并且当剩余的活动波达到其屏障指令时，认为屏障已满足。

查看英文原文

Work-groups are collections of wavefronts running on the same compute unit which can synchronize and share data. Up to 16 wavefronts (1024 work-items) can be combined into a work-group. When multiple wavefronts are in a workgroup, the S_BARRIER instruction can be used to force each wavefront to wait until all other wavefronts reach the same instruction; then, all wavefronts continue. Any wavefront can terminate early using S_ENDPGM, and the barrier is considered satisfied when the remaining live waves reach their barrier instruction.

4.4. 数据依赖处理

查看英文原文

4.4. Data Dependency Resolution

着色器硬件解决了大多数数据依赖性，但少数情况必须由着色器程序显式处理。在这些情况下，程序必须插入 S_WAITCNT 指令以确保先前的操作在继续之前已完成。

查看英文原文

Shader hardware resolves most data dependencies, but a few cases must be explicitly handled by the shader program. In these cases, the program must insert S_WAITCNT instructions to ensure that previous operations have completed before continuing.

着色器具有三个计数器，用于跟踪发出指令的进度。 S_WAITCNT 等待这些计数器的值等于或低于指定值，然后再继续。

查看英文原文

The shader has three counters that track the progress of issued instructions. S_WAITCNT waits for the values of these counters to be at, or below, specified values before continuing.

这些允许着色器编写器安排长延迟指令，执行不相关的工作，并指定何时需要长延迟操作的结果。

查看英文原文

These allow the shader writer to schedule long-latency instructions, execute unrelated work, and specify when results of long-latency operations are needed.

给定类型的指令按顺序返回，但不同类型的指令可以乱序完成。例如，GWS 和 LDS 指令都使用 LGKM_cnt，但它们可能会乱序返回。

查看英文原文

Instructions of a given type return in order, but instructions of different types can complete out-of-order. For example, both GWS and LDS instructions use LGKM_cnt, but they can return out-of-order.

VM_CNT：向量内存计数。确定内存读取何时将数据返回到 VGPRs，或者内存写入何时完成。

查看英文原文

VM_CNT: Vector memory count. Determines when memory reads have returned data to VGPRs, or memory writes have completed.

每次发出向量内存读取或写入（MUBUF、MTBUF 或 FLAT 格式）指令时递增。当数据已写回 VGPRs 时，读取递减；当数据写入 L2 缓存时，写入递减。排序：内存读取和写入按发出的顺序返回，包括混合读取和写入。

查看英文原文

Incremented every time a vector-memory read or write (MUBUF, MTBUF, or FLAT format) instruction is issued. Decremented for reads when the data has been written back to the VGPRs, and for writes when the data has been written to the L2 cache. Ordering: Memory reads and writes return in the order they were issued, including mixing reads and writes.

LGKM_CNT：（LDS、GWS、(K)constant、(M)essage）确定这些低延迟指令之一何时完成。

查看英文原文

LGKM_CNT: (LDS, GWS, (K)constant, (M)essage) Determines when one of these low-latency instructions have completed.

每发出一个 LDS 或 GWS 指令就加 1，标量内存读取的双字计数也加一（1 表示 1 个双字加载，2 表示 2 个双字或更大加载）。 S_memtime 与 s_load_dwordx2 的计数相同。每发出一个 FLAT 指令就加 1。当数据返回到 VGPRs 时，对于 LDS/GWS 读取或原子返回减 1。

Incremented by 1 for every LDS or GWS instruction issued, as well as by Dword-count for scalar-memory reads (1 for 1-dword loads, 2 for 2-dword or larger loads). 条件分支 (CBR) 图被分组为独立的代码块，在入口点用 FORK 表示，在出口点用 JOIN 表示。着色器编译器必须将这些指令添加到代码中。此方法使用六深堆栈，每个 fork/join 块需要三个 SGPRs。 Fork/Join 块可以分层嵌套到任意深度（符合 SGPR 要求）；它们还可以与其他条件流控制或计算跳转共存。

查看英文原文

Conditional Branch (CBR) graphs are grouped into self-contained code blocks, denoted by FORK at the entrance point, and JOIN and the exit point. The shader compiler must add these instructions into the code. This method uses a six-deep stack and requires three SGPRs for each fork/join block. Fork/Join blocks can be hierarchically nested to any depth (subject to SGPR requirements); they also can coexist with other conditional flow control or computed jumps.

This method compares how many of the 64 threads go down the PASS path instead of the FAIL path; then, it selects the path with the fewer number of threads first. This means at most 50% of the threads are active, and this limits the necessary stack depth to Log264 = 6.

第 5 章 标量 ALU 操作

查看英文原文

Chapter 5. Scalar ALU Operations

标量 ALU (SALU) 指令对每个波前的单个值进行操作。这些运算由 32 位整数算术和 32 或 64 位按位运算组成。 SALU 还可以直接在程序计数器上执行操作，允许程序在 SGPRs 中创建调用堆栈。许多操作还设置标量条件码位 (SCC) 以指示比较结果、进位或指令结果是否为零。

查看英文原文

Scalar ALU (SALU) instructions operate on a single value per wavefront. These operations consist of 32-bit integer arithmetic and 32- or 64-bit bit-wise operations. The SALU also can perform operations directly on the Program Counter, allowing the program to create a call stack in SGPRs. Many operations also set the Scalar Condition Code bit (SCC) to indicate the result of a comparison, a carry-out, or whether the instruction result was zero.

SALU 不能使用 VGPRs 或 LDS。 SALU 指令可以使用 32 位字面量常量。该常量是指令流的一部分，可用于除 SOPP 和 SOPK 之外的所有 SALU 微码格式。 字面量常量通过将源指令字段设置为“literal”（255）来使用，然后使用以下指令双字作为源值。

查看英文原文

The SALU cannot use VGPRs or LDS. SALU instructions can use a 32-bit literal constant. This constant is part of the instruction stream and is available to all SALU microcode formats except SOPP and SOPK. Literal constants are used by setting the source instruction field to "literal" (255), and then the following instruction dword is used as the source value.

如果任何源 SGPR 超出范围，则使用 SGPR0 的值。

查看英文原文

If any source SGPR is out-of-range, the value of SGPR0 is used instead.

如果目标 SGPR 超出范围，则不会将结果写入 SGPR。但是，写入了 SCC 和 EXEC（用于 saveexec）。

查看英文原文

If the destination SGPR is out-of-range, no SGPR is written with the result. However, SCC and EXEC (for saveexec) are written.

如果指令使用 SGPRs 中的 64 位数据，则​​ SGPR 对必须与偶数边界对齐。例如，使用 SGPRs 2 和 3 或 8 和 9（但不是 11 和 12）来表示 64 位数据是合法的。

查看英文原文

If an instruction uses 64-bit data in SGPRs, the SGPR pair must be aligned to an even boundary. For example, it is legal to use SGPRs 2 and 3 or 8 and 9 (but not 11 and 12) to represent 64-bit data.

5.3. 标量条件码（SCC）

查看英文原文

5.3. Scalar Condition Code (SCC)

标量条件码 (SCC) 是作为执行大多数 SALU 指令的结果而写入的。

查看英文原文

The scalar condition code (SCC) is written as a result of executing most SALU instructions.

SCC 由许多指令设置：

查看英文原文

The SCC is set by many instructions:

比较操作：1 = true。

查看英文原文

Compare operations: 1 = true.

算术运算：1 = 执行。

查看英文原文

Arithmetic operations: 1 = carry out.

SCC = 有符号加减运算溢出。对于加法，溢出=两个操作数符号相同，结果的 MSB（符号位）与操作数的符号不同。对于减法 (AB)，溢出 = A 和 B 具有相反的符号，并且结果符号与 A 的符号不同。

查看英文原文

SCC = overflow for signed add and subtract operations. For add, overflow = both operands are of the same sign, and the MSB (sign bit) of the result is different than the sign of the operands. For subtract (AB), overflow = A and B have opposite signs and the resulting sign is not the same as the sign of A.

位/逻辑运算： 1 = 结果不为零。

查看英文原文

Bit/logical operations: 1 = result was not zero.

第 6 章 向量 ALU 操作

查看英文原文

Chapter 6. Vector ALU Operations

向量 ALU 指令 (VALU) 对 64 个线程中的每一个线程的数据执行算术或逻辑运算，并将结果写回 VGPRs、SGPRs 或 EXEC 掩码。

查看英文原文

Vector ALU instructions (VALU) perform an arithmetic or logical operation on data for each of 64 threads and write results back to VGPRs, SGPRs or the EXEC mask.

6.1. 微码编码

查看英文原文

6.1. Microcode Encodings

大多数 VALU 指令有两种编码：VOP3 使用 64 位指令并具有全部功能，以及提供一组受限功能的三种 32 位编码之一。少数指令仅在 VOP3 编码中可用。

查看英文原文

Most VALU instructions are available in two encodings: VOP3 which uses 64-bits of instruction and has the full range of capabilities, and one of three 32-bit encodings that offer a restricted set of capabilities. A few instructions are only available in the VOP3 encoding.

当一条指令有两种微码格式时，由用户决定使用哪一种。建议尽可能使用 32 位编码。

查看英文原文

When an instruction is available in two microcode formats, it is up to the user to decide which to use. It is recommended to use the 32-bit encoding whenever possible.

微码编码如下所示。

查看英文原文

The microcode encodings are shown below.

VOP2 适用于具有两个输入和一个向量目标的指令。具有进位的指令隐式地将进位写入 VCC 寄存器。

查看英文原文

VOP2 is for instructions with two inputs and a single vector destination. Instructions that have a carry-out implicitly write the carry-out to the VCC register.

VOP1 适用于没有输入或单个输入和一个目标的指令。

查看英文原文

VOP1 is for instructions with no inputs or a single input and one destination.

VOPC 为比较指令。

查看英文原文

VOPC is for comparison instructions.

VOP3 适用于具有最多三个输入、输入修饰符（负值和绝对值）和输出修饰符的指令。 VOP3 有两种形式：一种使用标量目标字段（仅用于 div_scale，整数加减）；另一种使用标量目标字段（仅用于 div_scale，整数加减）；这被指定为 VOP3b。所有其他指令均使用通用形式，指定为 VOP3a。

查看英文原文

VOP3 is for instructions with up to three inputs, input modifiers (negate and absolute value), and output modifiers. There are two forms of VOP3: one which uses a scalar destination field (used only for div_scale, integer add and subtract); this is designated VOP3b. All other instructions use the common form, designated VOP3a.

任何 32 位微码格式都可以使用 32 位字面量常量，但不能使用 VOP3。

查看英文原文

Any of the 32-bit microcode formats may use a 32-bit literal constant, but not VOP3.

VOP3P 适用于使用“打包数学”的指令：它们对打包到每个操作数的高 16 位和低 16 位中的一对输入值执行运算；两个 16 位结果作为两个打包值写入单个 VGPR。

查看英文原文

VOP3P is for instructions that use "packed math": They perform the operation on a pair of input values that are packed into the high and low 16-bits of each operand; the two 16-bit results are written to a single VGPR as two packed values.

6.2. 操作数

查看英文原文

6.2. Operands

所有 VALU 指令至少接受一个输入操作数（V_NOP 和 V_CLREXCP 除外）。操作数的数据大小在指令名称中明确定义。例如，V_MUL_F32 对 32 位浮点数据进行操作。

查看英文原文

All VALU instructions take at least one input operand (except V_NOP and V_CLREXCP). The data-size of the operands is explicitly defined in the name of the instruction. For example, V_MUL_F32 operates on 32-bit floating point data.

6.2.1. 指令输入

查看英文原文

6.2.1. Instruction Inputs

VALU 指令可以使用以下任意输入源，但须遵守下列限制：

查看英文原文

VALU instructions can use any of the following sources for input, subject to restrictions listed below:

内联常量 - 由特定 VSRC 值选择的常量。

查看英文原文

Inline constants - constant selected by a specific VSRC value.

字面量常量 - 指令流中的 32 位值。当字面量常量与 64 位指令一起使用时，文字会通过以下方式扩展为 64 位：对于浮点数用零填充 LSB，对于无符号整数用零填充 MSB，以及通过符号扩展有符号整数。

查看英文原文

Literal constant - 32-bit value in the instruction stream. When a literal constant is used with a 64bit instruction, the literal is expanded to 64 bits by: padding the LSBs with zeros for floats, padding the MSBs with zeros for unsigned ints, and by sign-extending signed ints.

EXEC 面罩。

查看英文原文

EXEC mask.

局限性

查看英文原文

Limitations

每条指令最多可读取一个 SGPR，但该值可用于多个操作数。

查看英文原文

At most one SGPR can be read per instruction, but the value can be used for more than one operand.

最多可以使用一个字面量常量，并且仅当 SGPR 或 M0 不用作源时。

查看英文原文

At most one literal constant can be used, and only when an SGPR or M0 is not used as a source.

常量的限制

查看英文原文

Limitations for Constants

VALU“ADDC”、“SUBB”和 CNDMASK 都隐式使用 SGPR 值 (VCC)，因此这些指令不能使用额外的 SGPR 或字面量常量。

查看英文原文

VALU "ADDC", "SUBB" and CNDMASK all implicitly use an SGPR value (VCC), so these instructions cannot use an additional SGPR or literal constant.

使用 VOP3 形式并使用浮点输入的指令可以选择对任何输入操作数应用绝对值（ABS 字段）或求反（NEG 字段）。

查看英文原文

Instructions using the VOP3 form and also using floating-point inputs have the option of applying absolute value (ABS field) or negate (NEG field) to any of the input operands.

SDWA 和 OPSEL 的限制

查看英文原文

Limitations for SDWA and OPSEL

DOT 指令不得使用 SDWA 或 OPSEL。使用 SDWA 或 OPSEL 的 VALU 操作不得在下一个 VALU 指令中消耗该指令的结果 - 它们之间必须至少有一个独立指令或 V_NOP。

查看英文原文

DOT instructions must not use SDWA or OPSEL. VALU ops which use SDWA or OPSEL must not consume the result of that instruction in the next VALU instruction - there must be at least on independent instruction or V_NOP between them.

6.2.2. 指令输出

查看英文原文

6.2.2. Instruction Outputs

VALU 指令通常将其结果写入微码字的 VDST 字段中指定的 VGPRs。仅当 EXEC 掩码中的相关位设置为 1 时，线程才会写入结果。

查看英文原文

VALU instructions typically write their results to VGPRs specified in the VDST field of the microcode word. A thread only writes a result if the associated bit in the EXEC mask is set to 1.

所有 V_CMPX 指令将其比较结果（每个线程一位）写入 SGPR（或 VCC）和 EXEC 掩码。

查看英文原文

All V_CMPX instructions write the result of their comparison (one bit per thread) to both an SGPR (or VCC) and the EXEC mask.

当用于 VOP2 形式时，产生进位（整数加法和减法）的指令将其结果写入 VCC，当用于 VOP3 形式时，将其结果写入任意 SGPR 对。

查看英文原文

Instructions producing a carry-out (integer add and subtract) write their result to VCC when used in the VOP2 form, and to an arbitrary SGPR-pair when used in the VOP3 form.

当使用 VOP3 形式时，具有浮点结果的指令可以应用将结果乘以 0.5、1.0、2.0 或 4.0 的输出修饰符（OMOD 字段）。或者，可以将结果钳位（CLAMP 字段）到范围 [0.0, +1.0]。

查看英文原文

When the VOP3 form is used, instructions with a floating-point result can apply an output modifier (OMOD field) that multiplies the result by: 0.5, 1.0, 2.0 or 4.0. Optionally, the result can be clamped (CLAMP field) to the range [0.0, +1.0].

输出修饰符仅适用于浮点结果，对于整数或位结果将被忽略。输出修饰符与输出非规格化数不兼容：如果启用输出非规格化数，则输出修饰符将被忽略。如果输出非规格化数被禁用，则应用输出修改器并将非规格化数刷新为零。输出修饰符与 IEEE 不兼容：-0 刷新为 +0。如果 IEEE 模式位设置为 1，则忽略输出修饰符。

查看英文原文

Output modifiers apply only to floating point results and are ignored for integer or bit results. Output modifiers are not compatible with output denormals: if output denormals are enabled, then output modifiers are ignored. If output denormals are disabled, then the output modifier is applied and denormals are flushed to zero. Output modifiers are not IEEE compatible: -0 is flushed to +0. Output modifiers are ignored if the IEEE mode bit is set to 1.

6.4. Denormalized and Rounding Modes

着色器程序可以明确控制所应用的舍入模式以及非规格化输入和结果的处理。 MODE 寄存器使用 S_SETREG 指令设置；它有单独的位来控制单精度和双精度浮点数的行为。

查看英文原文

The shader program has explicit control over the rounding mode applied and the handling of denormalized inputs and results. The MODE register is set using the S_SETREG instruction; it has separate bits for controlling the behavior of single and double-precision floating-point numbers.

注意：对浮点数据进行操作的 V_DOT2 指令不支持非规格化数和舍入模式。它们刷新输入和输出范数。

查看英文原文

Note: that V_DOT2 instructions operating on floating point data do not support denormal and rounding modes. They flush input and output denorms.

6.5. ALU Clamp Bit Usage

当使用 V_CMP 指令时,将夹位设置为 1 表示如果出现浮点例外时的比较信号。对于整数操作,它会将结果夹到最大和最小的可代表值。对于浮点操作,它会将结果夹到范围:[0.0,1.0] 。

查看英文原文

When using V_CMP instructions, setting the clamp bit to 1 indicates that the compare signals if a floating point exception occurs. For integer operations, it clamps the result to the largest and smallest representable value. For floating point operations, it clamps the result to the range: [0.0, 1.0].

6.7. Packed Math

CDNA 支持压缩数学，它对 Dword 中的两个 16 位值执行运算，就好像它们是单独的元素一样。例如，V0=V1+V2 的压缩加法实际上是两个单独的加法：将每个 Dword 的低 16 位相加并将结果存储在 V0 的低 16 位中，然后将高半部分相加。

查看英文原文

CDNA supports packed math, which performs operations on two 16-bit values within a Dword as if they were separate elements. For example, a packed add of V0=V1+V2 is really two separate adds: adding the low 16 bits of each Dword and storing the result in the low 16 bits of V0, and adding the high halves.

打包数学使用以下指令和微码格式“VOP3P”。此格式为低操作数和高操作数添加了 op_sel 和负字段，并删除了 ABS 和 OMOD。

查看英文原文

Packed math uses the instructions below and the microcode format "VOP3P". This format adds op_sel and neg fields for both the low and high operands, and removes ABS and OMOD.

第 7 章 矩阵算术指令

查看英文原文

Chapter 7. Matrix Arithmetic Instructions

Matrix 核心是 CDNA 架构着色器指令集的扩展，支持机器智能 SIMD。矩阵核心有自己的 VGPR 文件：累加（“Acc”）GPRs。这与原始 SIMD 中的正常（建筑或“拱形”）VGPRs 是分开的。着色器 I/O 只能使用两种类型的 VGPRs。指令有一个 ACC 位来指示数据是否传输至架构或累加 VGPRs 或从 VGPRs 传输。数据可以通过 V_ACCVGPR_READ 和 V_ACCVGPR_WRITE 指令在 ACC 和 ARCH VGPRs 之间移动。

查看英文原文

Matrix core is an extension to CDNA architecture shader instruction set supporting the Machine Intelligence SIMD. The matrix core has its own VGPR file: the Accumulation ("Acc") GPRs. This is separate from the normal (Architectural, or "Arch") VGPRs in the original SIMD. Shader I/O can only use both types of VGPRs. Instructions have an ACC bit to indicate if data is transferred to/from architectural or accumulation VGPRs. Data can be moved between the ACC and ARCH VGPRs via the V_ACCVGPR_READ and V_ACCVGPR_WRITE instructions.

矩阵核心内部实现的核心运算是 4 × 1 乘以 1 × 4 外部矩阵乘积，产生 16 个输出值。外积既可以在密集输入上执行，也可以在 2,4 稀疏输入上执行（其中每组四个值中有两个为零）。矩阵核心单元使用这些操作的并行和串行组合来实现分段矩阵融合乘加 (MFMA) 中描述的稠密矩阵融合乘加 (MFMA) 指令及其稀疏矩阵分段中描述的 2,4 稀疏变体。

查看英文原文

The core operation implemented inside the matrix core is the 4 × 1 times 1 × 4 outer matrix product, yielding 16 output values. The outer product can be performed both on dense inputs and on 2,4 sparse ones (where two of each set of four values is zero). The matrix core unit uses combinations of these operations, both in parallel and in series, to implement the dense matrix-fused-multiply-add (MFMA) instructions described in Subsection Matrix fused-multiply-add (MFMA) and their 2,4-sparse variants described in Subsection Sparse Matrices.

由于这些矩阵指令不会在单个周期内产生输出，并且由于它们的部分写入结果可能是可观察到的，因此有时必须在发出矩阵核心指令和访问其结果或修改保存其输入的寄存器之间存在一定数量的独立指令，如“依赖项解析：所需的独立指令”小节中所述。

查看英文原文

Because these matrix instructions do not produce their output in a single cycle, and since their partially-written results may be observable, a certain amount of independent instructions must sometimes be present between the issuance of a matrix core instruction and accesses to its results or modification of the registers that hold its inputs, as described in Subsection Dependency Resolution: Required Independent Instructions.

其他信息可以在 GPUOpen 博客上找到：https://gpuopen.com/learn/amd-lab-notes/ amd-lab-notes-matrix-cores-README/ 这篇博客文章与 CDNA2 相关，但可能有助于理解 CDNA3。

查看英文原文

Additional information can be found on the GPUOpen blog: https://gpuopen.com/learn/amd-lab-notes/ amd-lab-notes-matrix-cores-README/ This blog post relates to CDNA2 but may be helpful with understanding CDNA3.

AMD 矩阵指令计算器 (https://github.com/RadeonOpenCompute/ amd_matrix_instruction_calculator) 包含一个帮助工具，允许开发人员查看有关 CDNA 架构中的 MFMA 指令的详细信息。它允许用户查询指令级信息，例如计算吞吐量和寄存器使用情况。它还允许用户为每个 MFMA 指令及其修饰符生成矩阵元素和硬件寄存器之间的映射。

查看英文原文

The AMD Matrix Instruction Calculator (https://github.com/RadeonOpenCompute/ amd_matrix_instruction_calculator) contains a helper tool that allows developers to view detailed information about the MFMA instructions in the CDNA architecture. It allows users to query instruction-level information such as computational throughput and register usage. It also allows users to generate mappings between matrix element and hardware registers for each MFMA instruction and their modifiers.

7.1. Matrix fused-multiply-add (MFMA)

矩阵融合乘加 (MFMA) 指令使用矩阵核心来执行一个或多个矩阵乘法。请注意，执行这些指令的矩阵核心单元将 4 × 1 x 1 × 4 外积作为其基本计算原语，因此 MFMA 指令实现类似外积的操作。

查看英文原文

The matrix fused-multiply-add (MFMA) instructions use the matrix core to perform one or more matrix multiplications. Note that the matrix core unit, which executes these instructions, has the 4 × 1 by 1 × 4 outer product as its fundamental computational primitive, and so the MFMA instructions implement outer-product-like operations.

这些指令的名称均采用 V_MFMA_[输出类型]_[M]X[N]X[K][_[B]B]_[输入类型] 形式，其中 B（如果未指定则为 1）是相乘的矩阵（或块）的数量，M、N 和 K 是每个块的乘法维度。例如，指令 V_MFMA_F32_32x32x1_2B_F32 执行以下操作

查看英文原文

These instructions all have names of the form V_MFMA_[output type]_[M]X[N]X[K][_[B]B]_[input type] where B (which is 1 if not specified) is the number of matrices (or blocks) that are multiplied, and M, N, and K, are the multiplication dimensions for each block. For example, the instruction V_MFMA_F32_32x32x1_2B_F32 perform the operations

其中 D[b,:,:] 和 C[b,:,:] 是 32 位浮点的 32 × 32 矩阵，A[b,:,:] 是浮点的 32 × 1 矩阵，

查看英文原文

where the D[b,:,:] and C[b,:,:] are 32 × 32 matrices of 32-bit floats, the A[b,:,:] are 32 × 1 matrices of floats,

MFMA 的输入和输出值可以存储在标准架构向量寄存器 (VGPRs) 或累加 VGPRs (AccVGPR) 中，这是矩阵核心单元专用的附加寄存器。保存矩阵 A 和 B 的寄存器的寄存器文件分别由 MFMA 指令的 ACC 字段的低位和高位控制（0 表示 VGPRs，1 表示 AccVGPR），而 ACC_CD 位确定 C 和 D 矩阵是否存储在 VGPRs（0）或 AccVGPR（1）中。可以使用 V_ACCVGPR_* 指令将数据移入或移出 AGPRs。

查看英文原文

The input and output values for an MFMA can be stored either in the standard architectural vector registers (VGPRs) or accumulation VGPRs (AccVGPRs), which are additional registers exclusive to the matrix core unit. The register file that the registers holding matrices A and B are controlled by the low and high bits, respectively, of the ACC field of a MFMA instruction (0 for VGPRs, 1 for AccVGPRs), while the ACC_CD bit determines if the C and D matrices are stored in VGPRs (0) or AccVGPRs (1). Data can be moved to and from AGPRs using the V_ACCVGPR_* instructions.

请注意，保存 MFMA 指令的输入或输出数据的寄存器必须是连续的，并且第一个寄存器必须与输入或输出所需的寄存器数量对齐。例如，如果指令需要矩阵 A 的四个输入寄存器，则可以使用寄存器 4 到 7（通过将 SRC0 设置为 4），但不能使用寄存器 5 到 8。

查看英文原文

Note that the registers holding input or output data for a MFMA instruction must be contiguous, and that the first register must be aligned to the number of registers required as the input or output. For instance, if an instruction requires four input registers for matrix A, registers 4 through 7 may be used (by setting SRC0 to 4) but not registers 5 through 8.

Semantically, for each 0 <= b < B, 0 <= i < M, and 0 <= j < N, it computes

其中每个 A[b,:,:] 为 M × K，每个 B[b,:,:] 为 K × N，每个 D[b,:,:] 和相应的 C[b,:,:] 为 M × N。

查看英文原文

where each A[b,:,:] is M × K, each B[b,:,:] is K × N, and each D[b,:,:] and corresponding C[b,:,:] is M × N.

输入和输出的值根据固定布局放入指令的参数中。为简单起见，此布局是根据波前的通道以及每个通道的项目序列来定义的：这些项目被排列到 32 位寄存器中，这些寄存器是小端形式的 MFMA 指令的真正参数。

查看英文原文

The values of the inputs and outputs are placed into the arguments to the instruction according to a fixed layout. For simplicity, this layout is defined in terms of the lanes of a wavefront and of the sequence of items for each lane: these items are arranged into the 32-bit registers that are the true arguments to an MFMA instruction in little-endian form.

For 32-bit quantities, each item corresponds to a distinct register

For 16-bit quantities, an item is half of a register, with the odd-numbered items taking up bits 31-16 and the even ones in bits 0-15

7.1.5.1. CBSZ and ABID

CBSZ 和 ABID 字段一起控制矩阵 A 块的广播。

查看英文原文

Together, the CBSZ and ABID fields control the broadcasting of the blocks of matrix A.

当 3 位 CBSZ 字段非零时，通道的一个块将其为矩阵 A 保存的值广播到通道的其他块，取代其他通道为 A 矩阵保存的值。设置 CBSZ 使得 (1 << CBSZ) 超过 MFMA 指令处理的块数是未定义的。

查看英文原文

When the 3-bit CBSZ field is non-zero, one block of lanes broadcasts the values it holds for matrix A to the other blocks of lanes, superseding the values those other lanes hold for the A matrix. Setting CBSZ such that (1 << CBSZ) exceeds the number of blocks the MFMA instruction processes is undefined.

广播块大小为

查看英文原文

The broadcast block size is

例如，如果 CBSZ 为 1，则 32 个通道的一个块为波前中的两组 32 个通道提供输入，而 CBSZ 为 3 意味着复制来自 8 个通道的块的值。

查看英文原文

For example, if CBSZ is 1, then one block of 32 lanes provides the inputs to both groups of 32 lanes in the wavefront, while CBSZ being 3 means that a the values from a block of 8 lanes are replicated.

CBSZ 的最大合法值为 4。

查看英文原文

The largest legal value of CBSZ is 4.

4 位 ABID 字段控制 S 通道的哪个块用作广播源。可能的块按顺序编号，ABID=0 对应选择通道 S-1:0，ABID=1 对应选择 2S-1:S，依此类推。例如，如果 CBSZ=2，则 ABID=1 表示通道 16 至 31 的值被广播到通道的其他三个块，而 ABID=3 表示通道 48 至 63 作为其输入源。

查看英文原文

The 4-bit ABID field controls which block of S lanes is used as the broadcast source. The possible blocks are numbered in order, with lanes S-1:0 being selected by ABID=0, 2S-1:S corresponding to ABID=1, and so on. For example, if CBSZ=2, then ABID=1 means the values from lanes 16 to 31 are broadcast, to the three other blocks of lanes, while ABID=3 means that lanes 48 to 63 serve as the source of their inputs.

设置 ABID 使得 ABID >= (1 << CBSZ) 是不合法的，因为此类值不引用潜在的源块。

查看英文原文

It is not legal to set ABID such that ABID >= (1 << CBSZ), as such values do not refer to a potential source block.

which is a 32 × 1 by 1 × 64 matrix multiplication if the two blocks of B are treated as one matrix with 64 rows.

CVT_SR_FP8_F32 OP_SEL 用途：

查看英文原文

CVT_SR_FP8_F32 OP_SEL usage:

使用 Src0 和 Src1 作为 VOP3 编码提供的输入，它添加两个操作数，注意不要使用基于操作码的 src1 尾数的 MSB，并在转换为 F8 类型之前依赖于随机轮的 F8 数据类型。然后，OP_SEL 位 3 和 2 被重新用于此 8b 写操作，并用于将生成的 8 位引导到 32b 输出的正确字节通道，保留目标的剩余 24b。

查看英文原文

Uses Src0 and Src1 as inputs supplied by the VOP3 encoding, it adds the two operands with attention to not use msbs of src1 mantissa based on opcode and dependent on the F8 data type for the stochastic round before converting to F8 type. Then OP_SEL bits 3 and 2 are repurposed for this 8b write op and used to steer the resulting 8 bits into the correct byte lane of the 32b output preserving the remaining 24b of the destination.

7.4. 稀疏矩阵

查看英文原文

7.4. Sparse Matrices

V_SMFMAC 指令系列对 4:2 结构稀疏矩阵 A 和稠密矩阵 B、C 和 D 执行矩阵乘法累加运算：D = C + A × B。

查看英文原文

The V_SMFMAC family of instructions perform matrix multiply-accumulate operations on a 4:2 structurally-sparse matrix A and dense matrices B, C, and D: D = C + A × B.

A 矩阵使用 4:2 结构化稀疏度表示，这意味着矩阵 K 维度上每 4 个元素中有两个为零。这些零不直接存储，而是在单独的 VGPR 中描述，该 VGPR 保存 2 位索引值对。索引值指示每组 4 个值中的哪两个值非零，并用于重建完整的 A 矩阵。非零样本紧密堆积，导致 2:1 压缩。只有 A 矩阵可能是稀疏的。

查看英文原文

The A matrix is represented using 4:2 structured sparsity which means that two out of every 4 elements along the matrix K-dimension are zero. These zeros are not stored directly but instead are described in a separate VGPR which holds pairs of 2-bit index values. The index values indicate which two values out of each group of 4 are non-zero and are used to reconstruct full A-matrix. Non-zero samples are tightly packed resulting in 2:1 compression. Only the A-matrix may be sparse.

这些 SMFMAC 指令都是“累加”操作，其中 C 和 D 矩阵相同，由指令的 VDST 字段（D 矩阵）引用。 C 操作数输入被重新用于保存索引数据偏移量。

查看英文原文

These SMFMAC instructions are all "accumulate" ops, where the C and D matrices are identical, referenced by the instruction’s VDST field (D-matrix). The C operand input is repurposed to hold the index data offset.

If CBSZ[1:0] =0, ABID[0] selects one of two 16-bit sets of sparse-indices within a VGPR starting at srcC containing 16-bits of index information for a lane. If CBSZ[1:0] !=0; the very first is selected (VGPR[srcC][15..0]).

所有 SMFMAC 指令必须遵循以下限制：

查看英文原文

All SMFMAC instructions must follow these restrictions:

矩阵 A 是稀疏矩阵，矩阵 B 是稠密矩阵。与矩阵 A 相比，ALU 从 VGPR 为矩阵 B 加载的数据多了一倍。

查看英文原文

The Matrix A is sparse matrix and matrix B is the dense matrix. The ALU loads twice more data from VGPR for matrix B comparing with matrix A.

矩阵 C 与结果矩阵相同。 ALU 使用 VDST VGPR 加载矩阵 C。所有指令均编码为累加操作码。

查看英文原文

Matrix C is the same as the result Matrix. The ALU uses the VDST VGPR to load matrix C. All instructions are encoded as accumulation opcodes.

src2 有索引编码（所有索引都在一个 VGPR 中），并且只能是 VGPR。索引数据提供有关 4 个 SRCA 中哪 2 个非零的信息。对于该索引对，索引 0 < 索引 1 & 索引 0 != 索引 1。

查看英文原文

Src2 has the index encoded (all of the indexes are in one VGPR) and it can only be VGPR. Index Data provides information about which 2 out 4 SRCA are non-zero. For this index pair, index 0 < index 1 & index0 != index1.

Src0、src1 和 VDST 的 VGPR 地址必须偶数对齐。

查看英文原文

The VGPR address of Src0, src1 and VDST must be even aligned.

CBSZ 和 ABID 控件仅用于从 VGPR 读取中选择索引，不会影响 SRCA 矩阵广播等。如为使用 CBSZ 和 ABID 控件的其他 MFMA 操作码所定义的。

查看英文原文

CBSZ and ABID controls are ONLY used to pick the index from the VGPR read and don’t affect SRCA matrix broadcast etc. as defined for other MFMA opcodes that use CBSZ and ABID controls.

SMFMAC 指令对 ACC_CD 的解释与其他指令不同：对于 SMFMAC，ACC_CD 位仅控制 DEST vgpr（arch 与 Accum），而不控制 SRC2 位置。 SRC2 参数提供由 SRC0 参数提供的稀疏数据的索引数据，该数据必须与 A 和 B 矩阵数据一起驻留在 ARCH-vgprs 中。换句话说，SRC2 的行为就好像 ACC_CD==0 一样。

查看英文原文

SMFMAC instructions interpret the ACC_CD differently from other instructions: For SMFMAC the ACC_CD bit control only the DEST vgpr (arch vs accum), not the SRC2 location. The SRC2 argument provides the index data for sparse data supplied by the SRC0 argument which must reside in the ARCH-vgprs along with the A and B matrix data. In other words SRC2 acts as if ACC_CD==0.

标量内存读取 (SMEM) 指令允许着色器程序通过标量数据缓存将数据从内存加载到 SGPRs，或通过标量数据缓存将数据从 SGPRs 写入内存。指令一次可以读取 1 到 16 个双字，或写入 1 到 4 个双字。数据直接读入 SGPRs，无需任何格式转换。

查看英文原文

Scalar Memory Read (SMEM) instructions allow a shader program to load data from memory into SGPRs through the Scalar Data Cache, or write data from SGPRs to memory through the Scalar Data Cache. Instructions can read from 1 to 16 Dwords, or write 1 to 4 Dwords at a time. Data is read directly into SGPRs without any format conversion.

标量单元在内存和 SGPRs 之间读取和写入连续的双字。这主要用于加载 ALU 常量。不支持数据格式，也不支持字节或短数据。

查看英文原文

The scalar unit reads and writes consecutive Dwords between memory and the SGPRs. This is intended primarily for loading ALU constants. No data formatting is supported, nor is byte or short data.

查看英文原文

The scalar memory unit supports the same set of memory atomics as the vector memory unit. Addressing is the same as for scalar memory loads and stores. Like the vector memory atomics, scalar atomic operations can return the "pre-operation value" to the SDATA SGPRs. This is enabled by setting the microcode GLC bit to 1.

8.3. Dependency Checking

标量内存读取和写入返回的数据可能与发出时的顺序无序；当读取跨越两个缓存行时，它们可以在不同时间返回部分结果。着色器程序使用 LGKM_CNT 计数器来确定数据何时返回到 SDST SGPRs。这是按如下方式完成的。

查看英文原文

Scalar memory reads and writes can return data out-of-order from how they were issued; they can return partial results at different times when the read crosses two cache lines. The shader program uses the LGKM_CNT counter to determine when the data has been returned to the SDST SGPRs. This is done as follows.

每次读取单个 Dword 时，LGKM_CNT 都会递增 1。

查看英文原文

LGKM_CNT is incremented by 1 for every fetch of a single Dword.

每次读取两个或多个双字时，LGKM_CNT 都会增加 2。

查看英文原文

LGKM_CNT is incremented by 2 for every fetch of two or more Dwords.

每条指令完成时，LGKM_CNT 都会递减等量。

查看英文原文

LGKM_CNT is decremented by an equal amount when each instruction completes.

由于指令可能会乱序返回，因此使用该计数器的唯一合理方法是实现 S_WAITCNT 0；这会强制等待所有数据从之前的 SMEM 返回，然后再继续。

查看英文原文

Because the instructions can return out-of-order, the only sensible way to use this counter is to implement S_WAITCNT 0; this imposes a wait for all data to return from previous SMEMs before continuing.

8.4. Alignment and Bounds Checking

对于两个双字（包括 S_MEMTIME）的读取，SDST 的值必须是偶数，对于更大的读取，SDST 的值必须是四的倍数。如果不遵守此规则，可能会导致无效数据。如果 SDST 超出范围，则不执行该指令。

查看英文原文

The value of SDST must be even for fetches of two Dwords (including S_MEMTIME), or a multiple of four for larger fetches. If this rule is not followed, invalid data can result. If SDST is out-of-range, the instruction is not executed.

对于 S_BUFFER_LOAD，SBASE 的值必须是偶数（指定 SGPR 的地址，它是四的倍数）。如果 SBASE 超出范围，则使用 SGPR0 中的值。

查看英文原文

The value of SBASE must be even for S_BUFFER_LOAD (specifying the address of an SGPR which is a multiple of four). If SBASE is out-of-range, the value from SGPR0 is used.

OFFSET 的值没有对齐限制。

查看英文原文

The value of OFFSET has no alignment restrictions.

Memory Address : If the memory address is out-of-range (clamped), the operation is not performed for any

超出范围的双字。

Chapter 9. Vector Memory Operations

向量内存（VMEM）指令将波前中的每个工作项的一条数据分别读取或写入 VGPRs。这与标量内存指令形成对比，标量内存指令移动由波前中的所有线程共享的单个数据。所有向量内存 (VM) 操作均由纹理缓存系统（1 级和 2 级缓存）处理。

查看英文原文

Vector Memory (VMEM) instructions read or write one piece of data separately for each work-item in a wavefront into, or out of, VGPRs. This is in contrast to Scalar Memory instructions, which move a single piece of data that is shared by all threads in the wavefront. All Vector Memory (VM) operations are processed by the texture cache system (level 1 and level 2 caches).

软件通过以下类型的 VMEM 指令之一通过纹理缓存启动加载、存储或原子操作：

查看英文原文

Software initiates a load, store or atomic operation through the texture cache through one of these types of VMEM instructions:

MTBUF：内存类型缓冲区操作。

查看英文原文

MTBUF: Memory typed-buffer operations.

MUBUF：内存无类型缓冲区操作。

查看英文原文

MUBUF: Memory untyped-buffer operations.

该指令定义哪些 VGPR 为操作提供地址，哪些 VGPRs 为操作提供或接收数据，以及一系列包含内存缓冲区描述符 (V#) 的 SGPRs。

查看英文原文

The instruction defines which VGPR(s) supply the addresses for the operation, which VGPRs supply or receive data from the operation, and a series of SGPRs that contain the memory buffer descriptor (V#).

9.1. 向量内存缓冲区指令

查看英文原文

9.1. Vector Memory Buffer Instructions

向量内存 (VM) 操作通过纹理缓存 (TC) 在 VGPRs 和内存中的缓冲区对象之间传输数据。向量意味着波前中的每个线程都会唯一地传输一个或多个数据，这与标量内存读取相反，标量内存读取仅传输由波前中的所有线程共享的一个值。

查看英文原文

Vector-memory (VM) operations transfer data between the VGPRs and buffer objects in memory through the texture cache (TC). Vector means that one or more piece of data is transferred uniquely for every thread in the wavefront, in contrast to scalar memory reads, which transfer only one value that is shared by all threads in the wavefront.

缓冲区读取可以选择将数据返回到 VGPRs 或直接返回到 LDS。

查看英文原文

Buffer reads have the option of returning data to VGPRs or directly into LDS.

缓冲区对象的示例有顶点缓冲区、原始缓冲区、流输出缓冲区和结构化缓冲区。

查看英文原文

Examples of buffer objects are vertex buffers, raw buffers, stream-out buffers, and structured buffers.

缓冲区对象支持同质和异构数据，但不过滤读取数据。缓冲区指令分为两组：

查看英文原文

Buffer objects support both homogeneous and heterogeneous data, but no filtering of read-data. Buffer instructions are divided into two groups:

MUBUF：无类型缓冲区对象。

查看英文原文

MUBUF: Untyped buffer objects.

数据格式在资源常量中指定。加载、存储、原子操作，带或不带数据格式转换。

查看英文原文

Data format is specified in the resource constant. Load, store, atomic operations, with or without data format conversion.

MTBUF：类型化缓冲区对象。

查看英文原文

MTBUF: Typed buffer objects.

数据格式在指令中指定。唯一的操作是加载和存储，两者都带有数据格式转换。

查看英文原文

Data format is specified in the instruction. The only operations are Load and Store, both with data format conversion.

原子操作从 VGPRs 获取数据，并将它们与内存中已有的数据进行算术组合。或者，可以将操作发生之前内存中的值返回给着色器。

查看英文原文

Atomic operations take data from VGPRs and combine them arithmetically with data already in memory. Optionally, the value that was in memory before the operation took place can be returned to the shader.

所有 VM 操作都使用缓冲区资源常量 (V#)，该常量是 SGPRs 中的 128 位值。当指令执行时，该常量被发送到纹理缓存。该常量定义了内存中缓冲区的地址和特征。通常，这些常量是在执行 VM 指令之前使用标量内存读取从内存中获取的，但这些常量也可以在着色器内生成。

查看英文原文

All VM operations use a buffer resource constant (V#) which is a 128-bit value in SGPRs. This constant is sent to the texture cache when the instruction is executed. This constant defines the address and characteristics of the buffer in memory. Typically, these constants are fetched from memory using scalar memory reads prior to executing VM instructions, but these constants also can be generated within the shader.

9.1.5. 缓冲区寻址

查看英文原文

9.1.5. Buffer Addressing

缓冲区是内存中的数据结构，通过索引和偏移量进行寻址。索引指向大小为 stride 字节的特定记录，偏移量是记录内的字节偏移量。步长来自资源、来自 VGPR（或零）的索引、来自 SGPR 或 VGPR 的偏移量以及来自指令本身的偏移量。

查看英文原文

A buffer is a data structure in memory that is addressed with an index and an offset. The index points to a particular record of size stride bytes, and the offset is the byte-offset within the record. The stride comes from the resource, the index from a VGPR (or zero), and the offset from an SGPR or VGPR and also from the instruction itself.

9.1.5.2. 重排缓冲区寻址

9.1.5.2. Swizzled Buffer Addressing

Swizzled 地址重排缓冲器中的数据,以帮助为数组结构提供更好的缓存位置。 Swizzled 地址也需要 Dword-access 访问。 单一的获取指令不能试图获取大于 Const- element- 大小的单位。 缓冲器的 STRIDE 必须是 element_size 的倍数 。

查看英文原文

Swizzled addressing rearranges the data in the buffer to help provide improved cache locality for arrays of structures. Swizzled addressing also requires Dword-aligned accesses. A single fetch instruction cannot attempt to fetch a unit larger than const-element-size. The buffer’s STRIDE must be a multiple of element_size.

9.1.6. 16 位内存操作

查看英文原文

9.1.6. 16-bit Memory Operations

D16 缓冲区指令允许核函数在 VGPRs 与内存之间为每个工作项仅加载或存储 16 位数据。这些指令有两种变体：

查看英文原文

The D16 buffer instructions allow a kernel to load or store just 16 bits per work item between VGPRs and memory. There are two variants of these instructions:

D16 将数据加载或存储到 VGPR 的下 16 位数据.

查看英文原文

D16 loads data into or stores data from the lower 16 bits of a VGPR.

D16_HI 将数据加载或存储到 VGPR 上 16 位的数据.

查看英文原文

D16_HI loads data into or stores data from the upper 16 bits of a VGPR.

例如,BUFFER_LOAD_UBYTE_D16 从内存中读取每个工作项的字节,将其转换成 16 位整数,然后加载到数据 VGPR 的下 16 位.

查看英文原文

For example, BUFFER_LOAD_UBYTE_D16 reads a byte per work-item from memory, converts it to a 16-bit integer, then loads it into the lower 16 bits of the data VGPR.

当启用 ECC 时, 16 位内存负载会写入完整的 32 位 VGPR 。 未使用的位数被设定为 0 。

查看英文原文

When ECC is enabled 16-bit memory loads write the full 32-bit VGPR. Unused bits are set to zero.

9.1.7. 对齐

查看英文原文

9.1.7. Alignment

对于 Dword 或更大的读或写,字节地址的两个 LSB 被忽略,从而迫使 Dword 对齐.

查看英文原文

For Dword or larger reads or writes, the two LSBs of the byte-address are ignored, thus forcing Dword alignment.

9.1.8. Buffer Resource

缓冲资源描述缓冲器在内存中的位置和缓冲器中的数据格式,在连续的 4 个 SGPRs(4 个对齐的 SGPRs)中指定,并发送到每个缓冲指令的纹理缓冲处.

查看英文原文

The buffer resource describes the location of a buffer in memory and the format of the data in the buffer. It is specified in four consecutive SGPRs (four aligned SGPRs) and sent to the texture cache with each buffer instruction.

9.1.9. 从内存缓冲区加载到 LDS

查看英文原文

9.1.9. Memory Buffer Load to LDS

MUBUF 指令格式允许从内存缓冲器直接读入 LDS,而不通过 VGPRs. 这为 MUBUF 指令的以下子集所支持.

查看英文原文

The MUBUF instruction format allows reading data from a memory buffer directly into LDS without passing through VGPRs. This is supported for the following subset of MUBUF instructions.

BUFFER_LOAD_{ubyte, sbyte, ushort, sshort, dword, format_x}.

查看英文原文

BUFFER_LOAD_{ubyte, sbyte, ushort, sshort, dword, format_x}.

LDS_offset = 16 位未署名字节从 M0[15:0]. Mem_offset = 32 位未署名字节从 SGPR (SOFFSET SGPR). idx_vgpr = 指数值从 VGPR (位于 VADDR). (Zero if idxen=0.) off_vgpr = 抵消值从 VGPR (位于 VADDR 或 VADDR+1). (Zero if offen=0.

查看英文原文

LDS_offset = 16-bit unsigned byte offset from M0[15:0]. Mem_offset = 32-bit unsigned byte offset from an SGPR (the SOFFSET SGPR). idx_vgpr = index value from a VGPR (located at VADDR). (Zero if idxen=0.) off_vgpr = offset value from a VGPR (located at VADDR or VADDR+1). (Zero if offen=0.)

9.1.9.1. Clamping Rules

内存地址夹与其它缓冲获取遵循相同的规则. LDS 地址夹:返回数据不得写入分配到此波的 LDS 空间之外.

查看英文原文

Memory address clamping follows the same rules as any other buffer fetch. LDS address clamping: the return data must not be written outside the LDS space allocated to this wave.

设定活动任务以限制缓冲读取那些将数据返回到合法 LDS 位置的线程 。

LDSbase（alloc）以 32 个双字为单位，LDSsize 也使用相同单位。

查看英文原文

The LDSbase (alloc) is in units of 32 Dwords, as is LDSsize.

9.1.10. 内存作用域与时间局部性控制

查看英文原文

9.1.10. Memory Scope and Temporal Control

9.1.10.1. 斯卡尔记忆

查看英文原文

9.1.10.1. Scalar Memory

标量 Memory 指令有一个单一的内存控制位点: GLC(Global Coherent). GLC 比特表示负载,存储,和原子操作的不同事物.

查看英文原文

Scalar Memory instructions have a single memory control bit: GLC (Globally Coherent). The GLC bit means different things for loads, stores, and atomic ops.

GLC = 0 读数可以击中 L1,并横跨波头持续着 GLC = 1 读数错过 L1 和 L2,并强制获取到数据结构. No L1 横跨波头持续着.

查看英文原文

GLC = 0 Reads can hit on the L1 and persist across wavefronts GLC = 1 Reads miss the L1 and L2 and force fetch to the data fabric. No L1 persistence across waves.

GLC = 0 Writes miss the L1 写到 L2 并持续在 L1 横跨波头. GLC = 1 Writes miss the L1 写到 L2 横跨波头没有坚持.

查看英文原文

GLC = 0 Writes miss the L1, write through to L2, and persist in L1 across wavefronts. GLC = 1 Writes miss the L1, write through to L2. No persistence across wavefronts.

GLC = 0 先前的数据值不返回. 无 L1 跨越波头的持久性. GLC = 1 先前的数据值返回. L1 跨越波头的持久性. 注: GLC 表示对动漫的"返回前置值".

查看英文原文

GLC = 0 Previous data value is not returned. No L1 persistence across wavefronts. GLC = 1 Previous data value is returned. No L1 persistence across wavefronts. Note: GLC means "return pre-op value" for atomics.

9.1.10.2. 病媒记忆

查看英文原文

9.1.10.2. Vector Memory

向量内存指令(Flat,Global,Scratch,和 Buffer)有 3 位来控制范围和缓存性:

查看英文原文

Vector Memory instructions (Flat, Global, Scratch, and Buffer) have 3 bits to control scope and cacheability:

SC[1:0]系统缓存级别:0=波,1=组,2=设备,3=系统

查看英文原文

SC[1:0] System Cache level: 0=wave, 1=group, 2=device, 3=system

NT 非时间:0=预计时间再利用;1=不期望时间再利用

查看英文原文

NT Non-Temporal: 0=expect temporal reuse; 1=do not expect temporal reuse

第 10 章 平坦内存指令

查看英文原文

Chapter 10. Flat Memory Instructions

平坦内存指令读取或写入 VGPRs 的一块数据; 平坦内存指令在波浪前端的每个工作项上单独进行。 平坦内存指令与缓冲或图像指令不同, 不使用资源常数来定义表面的基址 。 相反, 平坦内存指令使用 VGPR 的单一平面地址; 将内存作为单一平坦内存空间处理 。 这个内存空间包括视频内存、 系统内存、 LDS 内存和抓取( 私用) 内存 。 平坦内存空间的部分可能不会映射到任何真实内存, 访问这些区域会产生内存- 侵犯错误 。 确定地址地图的内存空间时, 由一组“ 模具孔径” 基和大小登记器控制 。

查看英文原文

Flat Memory instructions read, or write, one piece of data into, or out of, VGPRs; they do this separately for each work-item in a wavefront. Unlike buffer or image instructions, Flat instructions do not use a resource constant to define the base address of a surface. Instead, Flat instructions use a single flat address from the VGPR; this addresses memory as a single flat memory space. This memory space includes video memory, system memory, LDS memory, and scratch (private) memory. Parts of the flat memory space may not map to any real memory, and accessing these regions generates a memory-violation error. The determination of the memory space to which an address maps is controlled by a set of "memory aperture" base and size registers.

10.1. 平坦内存指令

查看英文原文

10.1. Flat Memory Instruction

平坦内存指令允许核函数在内存中读取或写入数据,或在已存在内存中的数据上执行原子操作。这些操作通过纹理 L2 缓存进行。该指令宣布 VGPR 持有地址(视内存配置而定,为 32 位或 64 位),发送的 VGPR 和接收数据的 VGPR。平面指令还使用 M0,如下表所示:

查看英文原文

Flat memory instructions let the kernel read or write data in memory, or perform atomic operations on data already in memory. These operations occur through the texture L2 cache. The instruction declares which VGPR holds the address (either 32- or 64-bit, depending on the memory configuration), the VGPR which sends and the VGPR which receives data. 10.2. Instructions

FLAT 指令集与缓冲指令集几乎完全相同,但没有 FORMAT 的读写. FLAT 指令与缓冲指令不同,不能直接返回数据到 LDS,只能返回 VGPRs.

查看英文原文

The FLAT instruction set is nearly identical to the Buffer instruction set, but without the FORMAT reads and writes. Unlike Buffer instructions, FLAT instructions cannot return data directly to LDS, but only to VGPRs.

FLAT 指令不使用资源常数(V#),但是它们确实需要特定的 SGPR-pair 来保存抓取空间信息,以防任何线程的地址决心抓取空间. 详情请参见 Scratch 一节.

查看英文原文

FLAT instructions do not use a resource constant (V#), however, they do require a specific SGPR-pair to hold scratch-space information in case any threads' address resolves to scratch space. See the Scratch section for details.

在内部,FLAT 指令既作为 LDS 指令,又作为缓冲指令执行;因此,VM_CNT 和 LGKM_CNT 均递增,在两者均被消减之前不视为完成,无法事先确定 FLAT 指令是只使用 LDS 还是 TA 内存空间.

查看英文原文

Internally, FLAT instruction are executed as both an LDS and a Buffer instruction; so, they increment both VM_CNT and LGKM_CNT and are not considered done until both have been decremented. There is no way beforehand to determine whether a FLAT instruction uses only LDS or TA memory space.

10.2.1. 顺序约束

查看英文原文

10.2.1. Ordering

平面指令可以互相完成。 如果一个平面指令在 Texture 缓存中找到它的全部数据, 而下一个指令在 LDS 中找到它的全部数据, 第二个指令可能首先完成。 如果两个指令将数据返回到相同的 VGPR , 则结果未知 。

查看英文原文

Flat instructions can complete out of order with each other. If one flat instruction finds all of its data in Texture cache, and the next finds all of its data in LDS, the second instruction might complete first. If the two fetches return data to the same VGPR, the result are unknown.

10.2.2. 重要时序要求

查看英文原文

10.2.2. Important Timing Consideration

由于 FLAT 载荷的数据可以来自 LDS 或纹理缓存,并且由于这些单位有不同的后缀,VM_CNT 和 LGKM_CNT 计数器有潜在的赛跑条件,因此 FLAT 指令后唯一明智的 S_WAITCNT 值为零.

查看英文原文

Since the data for a FLAT load can come from either LDS or the texture cache, and because these units have different latencies, there is a potential race condition with respect to the VM_CNT and LGKM_CNT counters. Because of this, the only sensible S_WAITCNT value to use after FLAT instructions is zero.

10.4. Global 全局内存

10.4. Global

全球指令与 Flat 指令类似,但程序员必须确保没有线程访问 LDS 空间;因此,全球指令没有使用 LDS 带宽.

查看英文原文

Chapter 11. Data Share Operations

本地数据共享(LDS)是一个非常低纬度的 RAM 抓图,用于临时数据,其有效带宽至少比直接的,无纹的全球内存高一个数量级。它允许在一个工作组中工作项之间共享数据。与只读缓存不同,LDS 允许对内存空间进行高速的写到读重用(完全收集/读/载和散/写/存储操作)。

查看英文原文

Local data share (LDS) is a very low-latency, RAM scratchpad for temporary data with at least one order of magnitude higher effective bandwidth than direct, uncached global memory. It permits sharing of data between work-items in a work-group. Unlike read-only caches, the LDS permits high-speed write-to-read re-use of the memory space (full gather/read/load and scatter/write/store operations).

实际定位在芯片上,直接靠近 ALU,LDS 大约可以比全球内存快一个数量级(假设没有银行冲突).

查看英文原文

Physically located on-chip, directly next to the ALUs, the LDS can be approximately one order of magnitude faster than global memory (assuming no bank conflicts).

每个计算单元有 64 kB 内存, 分割为 32 个 512 Dwords 的银行, 每个银行有 32 位宽. Dwords 被串行放置在银行中, 但所有银行可以同时执行一个存储或加载。 一个工作组可以请求最多 64 kB 内存。 跨波前的读数在瀑布的四个循环中发送 。

查看英文原文

There are 64 kB memory per compute unit, segmented into 32 banks of 512 Dwords, each bank being 32bits wide. Dwords are placed in the banks serially, but all banks can execute a store or load simultaneously. One work-group can request up to 64 kB memory. Reads across wavefront are dispatched over four cycles in waterfall.

LDS 内存的高带宽不仅通过接近 ALU 实现,而且还通过同时访问其内存库实现。因此,可以同时执行 32 个书写或读取指令,每个名义上是 32 位;扩展指令,读作 2/write2,每个可以是 64 位。但是,如果同时对同一银行进行不止一个访问尝试,就会发生银行冲突。在这种情况下,对于索引操作和原子操作,硬件可以阻止试图同时访问同一银行的行为。

查看英文原文

The high bandwidth of the LDS memory is achieved not only through its proximity to the ALUs, but also through simultaneous access to its memory banks. Thus, it is possible to concurrently execute 32 write or read instructions, each nominally 32-bits; extended instructions, read2/write2, can be 64-bits each. If, however, more than one access attempt is made to the same bank at the same time, a bank conflict occurs. In this case, for indexed and atomic operations, hardware prevents the attempted concurrent accesses to the same bank by

11.2. Dataflow in Memory Hierarchy

下图是内存结构内数据流的概念图.

查看英文原文

The figure below is a conceptual diagram of the dataflow within the memory structure.

要从全球内存中将数据加载到 LDS 中,它要从全球内存中读取,并放入工作项寄存器中;然后,储存到 LDS 中。类似地,要将数据从 LDS 中读取并放入工作项寄存器中,然后放入全球内存中。为了有效地使用 LDS,一个核函数必须在全球内存和 LDS 之间转移的东西上执行许多操作。也可以直接从内存缓冲器中装入 LDS 中的数据,绕过 VGPRs。

查看英文原文

To load data into LDS from global memory, it is read from global memory and placed into the work-item’s registers; then, a store is performed to LDS. Similarly, to store data into global memory, data is read from LDS and placed into the workitem’s registers, then placed into global memory. To make effective use of the LDS, a kernel must perform many operations on what is transferred between global memory and LDS. It also is possible to load data from a memory buffer directly into LDS, bypassing VGPRs.

LDS 在 LDS 硬件中进行. (因此,虽然 ALU 不是直接用于这些操作,但执行此功能的 LDS 会发生延迟. )

查看英文原文

LDS atomics are performed in the LDS hardware. (Thus, although ALUs are not directly used for these operations, latency is incurred by the LDS executing this function.)

11.3.1. Data Share Indexed and Atomic Access

索引化和原子化操作提供 VGPRs 到 LDS 每个工作项的独特地址,并将每个工作项的独特数据提供或返回到 VGPRs. 由于 LDS 的内部银行结构,根据银行冲突的数量(将这张地图映射到同一个内存库),操作最多只能完成两个周期,或者需要多达 64 个周期.

查看英文原文

Indexed and atomic operations supply a unique address per work-item from the VGPRs to the LDS, and supply or return unique data per work-item back to VGPRs. Due to the internal banked structure of LDS, operations can complete in as little as two cycles, or take as many 64 cycles, depending upon the number of bank conflicts (addresses that map to the same memory bank).

索引操作是简单的 LDS 加载和存储操作,从 VGPRs 读取数据并返回到 VGPRs.

查看英文原文

Indexed operations are simple LDS load and store operations that read data from, and return data to, VGPRs.

启用或禁用 VSKIP 模式 。

查看英文原文

Enables or disables VSKIP mode.

VSKIP 启用后,没有发布 VOP*/M*BUF/MIMG/DS/FLAT 指令. 注意 VSKIPed 内存指令不会操纵等待计数器;因此,如果存在未完成的内存请求,阴影器可能希望在启用 VSKIP 前发布 S_WAITCNT 0,否则阴影器必须注意在等待计数中不计算 VSKIPed 指令.

查看英文原文

When VSKIP is enabled, no VOP*/M*BUF/MIMG/DS/FLAT instructions are issued. Note that VSKIPped memory instructions do not manipulate the waitcnt counters; as a result, if there are outstanding memory requests the shader may want to issue S_WAITCNT 0 prior to enabling VSKIP, otherwise the shader must be careful not to count VSKIPped instructions in waitcnt calculations.

允许波浪在它的线组中“ 正在” 所有其他波浪, 以迫使它们从 S_SLEEP 指令中提前醒来 。

查看英文原文

Allow a wave to 'ping' all the other waves in its threadgroup to force them to wake up early from an S_SLEEP instruction.

如果波没有入睡, 便忽略了 ping 。 这样就可以在记忆位置上有效投票。 投票的波可以在记忆读数之间长长的 S_ SLEEP 中坐着, 但是, 写值的波可以让他们在数据可用后提早醒来。 这种方法也可以避免种族冲突, 因为任何在完成 S_ SLEEP 时错过 ping 恢复的波。

查看英文原文

The ping is ignored if the waves are not sleeping. This allows for efficient polling on a memory location. The waves which are polling can sit in a long S_SLEEP between memory reads, but the wave which writes the value can tell them all to wake up early now that the data is available. This method is also safe from races since any waves that miss the ping resume when they complete their S_SLEEP.

如果执行 S_WAKEUP 的波处于线组(in_tg set)中,那么它就会唤醒所有与同一线组 ID 相关的波。否则, S_WAKEUP 会被作为 S_NOP 处理 。

查看英文原文

If the wave executing S_WAKEUP is in a threadgroup (in_tg set), then it wakes up all waves associated with the same threadgroup ID. Otherwise, S_WAKEUP is treated as an S_NOP.

丢弃一条肮脏的标量( L0) 数据缓存行。 缓存行是 64 字节 。

查看英文原文

Discard one dirty scalar (L0) data cache line. A cache line is 64 bytes.

通常情况下, 脏缓存线( 由遮阳器写成 ) 会被写回内存, 但此指令允许遮阳器无效 , 而不是写回它以前写的缓存线 。 这是当遮阳器知道它不再需要该数据时使用的性能优化 。

查看英文原文

Typically, dirty cachelines (one which have been written by the shader) are written back to memory, but this instruction allows the shader to invalidate and not write back cachelines which it has previously written. This is a performance optimization to be used when the shader knows it no longer needs that data.

地址的计算与 S_STORE_DWORD 相同,但忽略了 6 个 LSB 以获得 64 字节对齐的地址. LGKM 计数为本 opcode 递增 1 个.

查看英文原文

Address is calculated the same as S_STORE_DWORD, except the 6 LSBs are ignored to get the 64 byte aligned address. LGKM count is incremented by 1 for this opcode.

丢弃连续两条肮脏的标量( L0) 数据缓存行。 缓存行是 64 字节 。

查看英文原文

Discard two consecutive dirty scalar (L0) data cache lines. A cache line is 64 bytes.

通常情况下, 脏缓存线( 由遮阳器写成 ) 会被写回内存, 但此指令允许遮阳器无效 , 而不是写回它以前写的缓存线 。 这是当遮阳器知道它不再需要该数据时使用的性能优化 。

查看英文原文

Typically, dirty cachelines (one which have been written by the shader) are written back to memory, but this instruction allows the shader to invalidate and not write back cachelines which it has previously written. This is a performance optimization to be used when the shader knows it no longer needs that data.

地址的计算与 S_STORE_DWORD 相同,但忽略了 6 个 LSB,以获得 64 字节对齐的地址. LGKM 计数在此 opcode 中递增 2 个.

查看英文原文

Address is calculated the same as S_STORE_DWORD, except the 6 LSBs are ignored to get the 64 byte aligned address. LGKM count is incremented by 2 for this opcode.

Instructions in this format may also be encoded as VOP3. This allows access to the extra control bits (e.g. ABS, OMOD) in exchange for not being able to use a literal constant. The VOP3 opcode is: VOP2 opcode + 0x140.

12.9. VOPC Instructions

VOPC 的位场映射是 :

查看英文原文

The bitfield map for VOPC is:

比较指示使用该通道的私人数据在每条通道(工程项目或线程)上进行相同的比较操作,并产生每条通道 1 位结果,形成 VCC 或 EXEC.

查看英文原文

Compare instructions perform the same compare operation on each lane (workItem or thread) using that lane’s private data, and producing a 1 bit result per lane into VCC or EXEC.

这种格式的指令可能使用一个 32 位的字元常数,该常数在指令后立即出现.

查看英文原文

Instructions in this format may use a 32-bit literal constant which occurs immediately after the instruction.

大多数比较指令属于两类之一:

查看英文原文

Most compare instructions fall into one of two categories:

可以使用 16 个操作之一的操作( 浮点类型) 。 "{COMPF}"

查看英文原文

Those which can use one of 16 compare operations (floating point types). "{COMPF}"

可以使用 8 个操作之一的操作(整数类型). "{COMPI}"

查看英文原文

Those which can use one of 8 compare operations (integer types). "{COMPI}"

opcode 编号使得对于这些,opcode 编号可以从数据类型的基础 opcode 编号中计算出来,加上特定比较操作的偏移.

查看英文原文

The opcode number is such that for these the opcode number can be calculated from a base opcode number for the data type, plus an offset for the specific compare operation.

S1.u[0] value is a signaling NAN. S1.u[1] value is a quiet NAN. S1.u[2] value is negative infinity. S1.u[3] value is a negative normal value. S1.u[4] value is a negative denormal value. S1.u[5] value is negative zero. S1.u[6] value is positive zero. S1.u[7] value is a positive denormal value. S1.u[8] value is a positive normal value. S1.u[9] value is positive infinity.

说明

查看英文原文

Notes

注意 S1 的格式为 f16,因为浮点字面常数被解释为这个 opcode 的 16 位值.

查看英文原文

Note that the S1 has a format of f16 since floating point literal constants are interpreted as 16 bit value for this opcode.

V_DIV_SCALE_F32,V_DIV_FMAS_F32 和 V_DIV_FIXUP_F32 均被设计用于高精度的分区宏中,利用 V_RCP_F32 和 V_MUL_F32 来计算大致结果,然后应用牛顿-拉弗森方法的两个步骤来趋同到商数. 如果在计算中出现次常数,则发生精度损失。这种精度损失可以通过缩小输入量,然后在牛顿-拉弗森应用后对商数进行测算来避免。

V_DIV_SCALE_F32, V_DIV_FMAS_F32 and V_DIV_FIXUP_F32 are all designed for use in a high precision division macro that utilizes V_RCP_F32 and V_MUL_F32 to compute the approximate result and then applies two steps of the Newton-Raphson method to converge to the quotient. If subnormal terms appear during this calculation then a loss of precision occurs. This loss of precision can be avoided by scaling the inputs and then post-scaling the quotient after Newton-Raphson is applied.

鉴于在第一个输入中具有双精度浮点值,在第二个输入中具有分母值,在第三个输入中具有一个数字值,如果为了避免在应用牛顿-拉夫森校正方法时出现非正常名词而需要,则将第一个输入分母缩放。如果需要后缩放,则将缩放结果存储到向量寄存器中并设定向量条件码。

The first input is an 8-entry array of unsigned 8-bit integers, the second input is a 4-entry array of unsigned 8-bit integers and the third input is a 4-entry array of unsigned 16-bit integers.

Given a half-precision float quotient in the first input, a denominator in the second input and a numerator in the third input, detect and apply corner cases related to division, including divide by zero, NaN inputs and overflow, and modify the quotient accordingly. 此操作在除以 0 和 NaN 输入等分区宏中处理角大小写。 当商数大约等于分母除以数字时, 此操作被定义良好 。 其他输入会产生可预测的结果, 但可能不会在数学上有用 。

查看英文原文

This operation handles corner cases in a division macro such as divide by zero and NaN inputs. This operation is well defined when the quotient is approximately equal to the numerator divided by the denominator. Other inputs produce a predictable result but may not be mathematically useful.

查看英文原文

The FFT mode (offset >= 0xe000) swizzles the input based on offset[4:0] to support FFT calculation. Example swizzles using input {1, 2, … 20} are:

旋转模式（offset >= 0xc000 且 offset < 0xe000）按 offset[9:5] 指定的线程数量移动输入：offset[10] == 0 时向左旋转，offset[10] == 1 时向右旋转。该模式还使用掩码修改旋转结果。例如，mask == 1 时，左旋会将奇数线程跨过间隔的偶数线程进行交换；右旋则将偶数线程跨过间隔的奇数线程进行交换。

查看英文原文

The rotate mode (offset >= 0xc000 and offset < 0xe000) rotates the input either left (offset[10] == 0) or right (offset[10] == 1) a number of threads equal to offset[9:5]. The rotate mode also uses a mask value which can alter the rotate result. For example, mask == 1 swaps the odd threads across every other even thread (rotate left), or even threads across every other odd thread (rotate right).

The first basic swizzle mode (when offset[15] == 1) allows full data sharing between a group of 4 consecutive threads. Any thread within the group of 4 can get data from any other thread within the group of 4, specified by the corresponding offset bits --- [1:0] for the first thread, [3:2] for the second thread, [5:4] for the third thread, [7:6] for the fourth thread. Note that the offset bits apply to all groups of 4 within a wavefront; thus if offset[1:0] == 1, then thread0 grabs thread1, thread4 grabs thread5, etc.

第二个基本的 swizzle 模式( 当 offset[15] == 0) 允许在 32 个连续线程之间进行有限的数据共享 。 在此情况下, 偏移用于指定一个 5 位 xor mask, 5 位或 mask, 以及 5 位和 mask 生成线程映射。 请注意, 偏移位数适用于波前的每组 32 个。 线程映射的细节如下 。 一些实例使用 :

In this case, the offset is used to specify a 5-bit xor-mask, 5-bit or-mask, and 5-bit and-mask used to generate a thread mapping. 第 13 章 微码格式

查看英文原文

Chapter 13. Microcode Formats

本节指定了微码格式。定义可以通过提供各种指令格式的标准模板和点名来简化汇编。

查看英文原文

This section specifies the microcode formats. The definitions can be used to simplify compilation by providing standard templates and enumeration names for the various instruction formats.

Endian Order - CDNA 架构用很少的端元字节排序和位元排序处理内存和登记。多位字节值用最小的(低序)字节(LSB)存储在最小的字节地址,它们用它们的 LSB 在右边显示。字节值用最小的(低序)字节(lsb)存储在最小的位地址,用它们的 Isb 在右边显示。

查看英文原文

Endian Order - The CDNA architecture addresses memory and registers using little endian byte-ordering and bit-ordering. Multi-byte values are stored with their least-significant (low-order) byte (LSB) at the lowest byte address, and they are illustrated with their LSB at the right side. Byte values are stored with their least-significant (low-order) bit (lsb) at the lowest bit address, and they are illustrated with their lsb at the right side.

The field-definition tables that accompany the descriptions in the sections below use the following notation.

int(2) - 指定无符号整数的双位字段。

查看英文原文

int(2) - A two-bit field that specifies an unsigned integer value.

enum(7) - 一个七位字段,指定了一组已列出的值(在这种情况下,最多为 27 个值)。有效值的数量可能小于最大值。

查看英文原文

enum(7) - A seven-bit field that specifies an enumerated set of values (in this case, a set of up to 27 values). The number of valid values can be less than the maximum.

所有字段的默认值为零。任何未识别的比特字段都被假定为保留 。

查看英文原文

The default value of all fields is zero. Any bitfield not identified is assumed to be reserved.

指令后缀

查看英文原文

Instruction Suffixes

多数指令包含一个后缀,表示指令手柄的数据类型。这个后缀可能还包括一个数字,表示数据大小。

查看英文原文

Most instructions include a suffix which indicates the data type the instruction handles. This suffix may also include a number which indicate the size of the data.

例如:"F32"表示"32 位浮点数据",或"B16"表示"16 位二进制数据".

查看英文原文

For example: "F32" indicates "32-bit floating point data", or "B16" is "16-bit binary data".

B = 二进制

查看英文原文

B = binary

F = 浮点

查看英文原文

F = floating point

U = 无符号整数

查看英文原文

U = unsigned integer

S = 签名整数

查看英文原文

S = signed integer

当一个指令中出现一个以上的数据类型描述符时,最后一个是结果类型和大小,而前一个(s)是/是输入数据类型和大小.

查看英文原文

When more than one data-type specifier occurs in an instruction, the last one is the result type and size, and the earlier one(s) is/are input data type and size.

原 PDF 第 535 页

最后的 opcode 编号是通过将 opcode 家族的基数加上比较 op 的偏移来决定的。 每个比较指令都会写出 VCC(为 VOPC)或 SGPR(为 VOP3)的结果。此外,比较指令还有变体,也写到 EXEC 的面具。比较结果的目的地是使用 VOPC 格式编码时的 VCC,在 VOP3 格式编码时可以是任意的 SGPR。

查看英文原文

The final opcode number is determined by adding the base for the opcode family plus the offset from the compare op. Every compare instruction writes a result to VCC (for VOPC) or an SGPR (for VOP3). Additionally, compare instruction have variants that also writes to the EXEC mask. The destination of the compare result is VCC when encoded using the VOPC format, and can be an arbitrary SGPR when encoded in the VOP3 format.

Control Broadcasting Size: 向 2CBSZ 输入其它矩阵乘法块播放 A 矩阵的一个选定块。 任何 MFMA 指令中的法律值 = 0– 4, 但不得大于 log2( blocks ) 。 要播放的块 ID 来自 ABID。 定义一个组内可以进行广播的块数。 法律值 = 0– 4。 这个组的块 ID 来自 ABID 。

查看英文原文

Control Broadcast Size: Broadcast one chosen block of the A matrix to the input of 2CBSZ other blocks of matrix multiplication. Legal values = 0-4, but must not be greater than log2(blocks) for any MFMA instruction. The block ID to broadcast comes from ABID. Defines the number of blocks that can do a broadcast within a group. Legal values = 0-4. The block ID of this group comes from ABID.

A-matrix Broadcasting Identifer:当 CBSZ 被设定为非零值时,在每组毗连的 2CBSZ 区块内,此选项选择 A 的哪个区块向其他区的矩阵乘法输入广播.

查看英文原文

A-matrix Broadcast Identifier: When CBSZ is set to a non-zero value, within each contiguous set of 2CBSZ blocks, this chooses which block of A to broadcast to the matrix multiplication inputs of the others.

查看英文原文

“B”-Matrix Lane-Group Pattern. Controls how to swizzle the matrix lane groups (LG) in VGPRs when doing matrix multiplication by controlling the swizzle muxes. For V_MFMA_F64_4X4X4F64 and V_MFMA_F64_16X16X4F64 this field specifies the NEG modifier instead of BLGP.

Bank 掩码仅控制目标 VGPR 的写入，不改变读取源 VGPR 数据时的线程掩码。第 27 位为 0：禁用 lanes[12:15, 28:31, 44:47, 60:63]；第 26 位为 0：禁用 lanes[8:11, 24:27, 40:43, 56:59]；第 25 位为 0：禁用 lanes[4:7, 20:23, 36:39, 52:55]；第 24 位为 0：禁用 lanes[0:3, 16:19, 32:35, 48:51]。这里的 bank 与 VGPR 寄存器组中的 bank 含义不同。

查看英文原文

Bank Mask Applies to the VGPR destination write only, does not impact the thread mask when fetching source VGPR data. 27==0: lanes[12:15, 28:31, 44:47, 60:63] are disabled 26==0: lanes[8:11, 24:27, 40:43, 56:59] are disabled 25==0: lanes[4:7, 20:23, 36:39, 52:55] are disabled 24==0: lanes[0:3, 16:19, 32:35, 48:51] are disabled Notice: the term "bank" here is not the same as we used for the VGPR bank.

Row 行掩码仅控制目标 VGPR 的写入，不改变读取源 VGPR 数据时的线程掩码。第 31 位为 0：禁用 lanes[63:48]，仅适用于 64 线程波前；第 30 位为 0：禁用 lanes[47:32]，仅适用于 64 线程波前；第 29 位为 0：禁用 lanes[31:16]；第 28 位为 0：禁用 lanes[15:0]。

查看英文原文

Row Mask Applies to the VGPR destination write only, does not impact the thread mask when fetching source VGPR data. 31==0: lanes[63:48] are disabled (wave 64 only) 30==0: lanes[47:32] are disabled (wave 64 only) 29==0: lanes[31:16] are disabled 28==0: lanes[15:0] are disabled

13.6. Flat 格式

查看英文原文

13.6. Flat Formats

平坦内存指令分为三种：FLAT：每个工作项的内存地址可以位于全局内存、暂存（私有）内存或共享内存（LDS）。GLOBAL：与 FLAT 类似，但假定所有地址均指向全局内存。SCRATCH：与 FLAT 类似，但假定所有地址均指向暂存（私有）内存。

查看英文原文

Flat memory instructions come in three versions: FLAT:: memory address (per work-item) may be in global memory, scratch (private) memory or shared memory (LDS) GLOBAL:: same as FLAT, but assumes all memory addresses are global memory. SCRATCH:: same as FLAT, but assumes all memory addresses are scratch (private) memory.

微码格式对每个都相同,只有 SEG(片段)字段的值不同.

查看英文原文

The microcode format is identical for each, and only the value of the SEG (segment) field differs.

VGPR, 持有地址或抵消。 对于 64 位地址, ADDR 拥有 LSB, ADDR+1 拥有 MSB。 对于一个 VGPR 有 32 位无符号的偏移。 对于 FLAT_*: 指定地址。 对于 Global_*和 SCRATCH_*, SADR 是 0x7f: 指定地址。 对于 Global_*和 SCRATCH_*, SADR 不是 0x7f, 请指定一个偏移 。

查看英文原文

VGPR which holds address or offset. For 64-bit addresses, ADDR has the LSB’s and ADDR+1 has the MSBs. For offset a single VGPR has a 32 bit unsigned offset. For FLAT_*: specifies an address. For GLOBAL_* and SCRATCH_* when SADDR is 0x7f: specifies an address. For GLOBAL_* and SCRATCH_* when SADDR is not 0x7f: specifies an offset.

VGPR 提供数据.

查看英文原文

VGPR which supplies data.

标量 SGPR 提供了一个偏移地址( 无符号) 。 设置此字段为 0x7f 以禁用 。 此字段的含义对 Scratch 和 Global 不同 : FLAT : 未使用字节 : 使用 SGPR 而不是 VGPR Global : 使用 SGPR 提供基址, VGPR 提供 32 位字节的偏移 。

查看英文原文

Scalar SGPR which provides an address of offset (unsigned). Set this field to 0x7f to disable use. Meaning of this field is different for Scratch and Global: FLAT: Unused Scratch: use an SGPR for the address instead of a VGPR Global: use the SGPR to provide a base address and the VGPR provides a 32-bit byte offset.
